title: Research Fellow-3
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Research Fellow-3 role at Inside Higher Ed .

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will participate in the Neurodegeneration Computational Fellows Training Program (NDCF) at Howard University, developing and applying computational skills in neuroscience research. Under the mentorship of host labs, the fellow will contribute to analyzing datasets related to neurodegenerative diseases, such as Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, or traumatic brain injury (TBI), advancing the understanding of disease mechanisms. This role supports the program’s mission to train researchers in advanced mathematics, data analysis, and bioinformatics for neurodegeneration research.

Supervisory Authority

This position has no supervisory authority. The fellow will work directly under the supervision of a principal investigator or mentor in a host lab affiliated with the NDCF program, receiving guidance on research tasks and computational training.

Nature And Scope

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will engage in interdisciplinary research within a host lab at Howard University or a partner institution, such as NIH/NINDS, focusing on computational approaches to neurodegeneration. The fellow will gain hands-on experience analyzing neurophysiological, genomic, or imaging data using tools like Python, R, or machine learning frameworks. The fellow will collaborate with researchers, other fellows, and faculty, participating in lab meetings and NDCF symposia. The role is designed to support professional growth by developing skills in data analysis and contributing to research publications. External opportunities may include presenting at conferences or collaborating with partners in the Neurodegeneration Challenge Network (NDCN) under the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Assist in analyzing datasets (e.g., MRI, genomic, or microbiome data) using computational tools under the guidance of a mentor, identifying patterns or biomarkers in neurodegenerative diseases.
  • Learn and apply statistical or machine learning methods to support research on disease mechanisms, following lab protocols.
  • Support data processing tasks, such as image analysis or sequence alignment, using provided software or scripts.
  • Prepare research summaries and present findings at NDCF symposia, lab meetings, or external conferences.
  • Contribute to team discussions, collaborating with lab members to integrate computational and experimental findings.
  • Maintain accurate records of research activities and adhere to ethical standards in data handling and reporting.

Core Competencies

  • Computational Aptitude: Basic familiarity with programming (e.g., Python, R) or data analysis tools, with a strong interest in learning advanced computational techniques.
  • Analytical Thinking: Ability to approach complex datasets with curiosity and apply structured methods to derive meaningful insights under mentorship.
  • Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams, including researchers, students, and faculty.
  • Communication: Clear written and verbal communication to present research progress and engage with scientific audiences.
  • Adaptability: Eagerness to acquire new skills and adapt to evolving research tools and methodologies in a training-focused environment.

Minimum Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in neuroscience, biology, computer science, bioinformatics, or a related field.
  • Experience: Some exposure to programming, data analysis, or neuroscience research through coursework, internships, or personal projects. No prior expertise required.
  • Skills: Basic familiarity with computational tools (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB, or command-line interfaces) or a strong interest in learning these skills. Introductory knowledge of statistics or data visualization is a plus.
  • Other: Demonstrated interest in neurodegeneration research and the ability to work collaboratively under mentorship guidance.

Overview

Job ID: | Amazon Logistica do Brasil

Você quer trabalhar duro, se divertir e fazer história? Se sim, a Amazon pode ser a escolha de carreira certa para você. Nossas equipes de logística estão mudando a maneira como interagimos com clientes em todo o mundo todos os dias e resolvendo alguns dos maiores desafios logísticos enfrentados não apenas pela Amazon, mas também por toda a indústria. As equipes de transporte da Amazon trabalham para garantir a entrega de pacotes para clientes em todo o mundo. Sejam itens grandes ou pequenos, encontramos soluções para garantir que estamos cumprindo nossa promessa para os clientes. A equipe da Amazon Logística está em busca de um(a) Líder de Time para se juntar à equipe da AMZL Brasil para a nossa Delivery Station em Hidrolândia, GO.

Como líder de equipe, você supervisionará uma de nossas estações de entrega, fornecendo liderança aos associados e gerenciando o desempenho dos principais indicadores – Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). A função envolve prosperar e entregar resultados em um ambiente ambíguo, rápido e dinâmico, em um espaço colaborativo que é mais próximo de uma start-up do que de uma grande empresa.

Responsabilidades

  • Estar presencialmente na estação de entrega; trabalhar em turnos variados, incluindo finais de semana e feriados.
  • Criar e cultivar um ambiente de trabalho seguro, identificando oportunidades de segurança na área de trabalho.
  • Liderar e treinar os associados para entregar o melhor serviço aos nossos clientes.
  • Garantir que os pedidos dos clientes sejam atendidos de acordo com diretrizes de segurança e qualidade.
  • Fornecimento contínuo de informações críticas relacionadas ao turno aos operadores.
  • Envolver-se com funções de suporte e/ou outros departamentos para abordar problemas ou necessidades de indicadores de desempenho (ex.: readiness, 5S, segurança, treinamento).
  • Monitorar o andamento das rotas, identificar desvios e ajustar com foco na superação da expectativa do cliente e no gerenciamento dos custos de operação.
  • Conduzir reuniões, atribuir funções e trabalhar com KPIs como despacho pontual, sucesso na entrega no primeiro dia e melhoria do atendimento ao cliente.
  • Focar em métricas e identificar causas raízes para impulsionar melhorias.
  • Encontrar soluções práticas para problemas complexos sem comprometer a qualidade ou a funcionalidade principal.
  • Fornecer suporte diário durante o lançamento/implementação de sistemas e processos mais novos e coletar feedback.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de software e hardware para garantir operações diárias; garantir que os associados tenham ferramentas adequadas e coordenar reparo ou substituição quando necessário.
  • Comunicar métricas diárias e relatar exceções a outros departamentos em Operações e na Amazon, conforme necessário.

Requisitos / Qualificações

  • Capacidade de liderar e treinar equipes; foco em resultados e KPIs.
  • Disposição para trabalhar em turnos 24-7, incluindo finais de semana e feriados.
  • Habilidade para prosperar em um ambiente rápido, ambíguo e colaborativo.
  • Engajamento com melhoria contínua, análise de métricas e resolução de problemas.
  • Uso de ferramentas de software e hardware para operações diárias;
  • Comunicação eficaz e capacidade de reportar status e questões a várias áreas.

Notas legais e Inclusão

Nossa cultura inclusiva capacita os Amazonians a oferecer os melhores resultados para nossos clientes. Não celebramos apenas a diversidade de nossa força de trabalho, celebramos as diversas formas como trabalhamos. Se você quiser solicitar uma acomodação para a entrevista ou o processo de integração, avise seu recrutador e ele o conectará à nossa equipe de acomodação.

title: Senior Software Engineer I, Unified Experience
description:
Overview

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence. Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure. Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital. For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You'll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. As a Senior Engineer, you will be building and shaping our product for Private Equity clients. In particular, you’ll be one of the key contributors in improving operational efficiency, building new features while capitalizing on standardized solutions. Working in close collaboration with both business and engineering teams within Carta, we navigate a unique and challenging product space that intersects with multiple domains including Cap Table Management, Fund admins, and various other teams.

The Team You\'ll Work With

The Unified Experience for PE team at Carta helps private equity firms easily see and manage their portfolio companies by creating connected and user-friendly tools. The team’s core focus is to create a unified experience for investors — including detailed views for PE-backed LLCs.

Some of the key problem areas you will be working on:

  • Fragmented experience - The platform lacks unified dashboards for all investment entities, especially PE-backed LLCs, making portfolio overviews difficult.
  • Missing Valuations and Insights - Key information (valuations, holdings, financials, KPIs) is not easily accessible for PE-backed LLCs and FA issuers, limiting transparency.
  • Cumbersome Entry to Key Products - No streamlined way to access essential tools (e.g., valuations, data monitoring) from portfolio views.
  • Disconnected Platform Workflows - Data and workflows across investments, valuation, and reporting aren’t well integrated—impacting product launches and analytics.

About You

You deeply care about your users and are relentless in your pursuit to build enterprise-grade applications. You are energized by solving deep problems collaboratively and can easily transition between a Solver and Tech Lead archetype. Additionally:

  • You have 5+ years of frontend or full-stack engineering experience.
  • You have experience in architecting complex SaaS products with Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) and microservices.
  • You are passionate about some elements of our tech stack (ReactJS, Typescript, React Queries, Storybook, Amplitude, Ink (we invite you to check out our very own ink.carta.com)).
  • You are excited to work with stakeholders across engineering, product, business, and marketing.
  • You have an interest in AI/ML technologies and are eager to explore how they can be applied to improve product experiences.
  • You have a desire to become a product domain expert and refine ambiguous product requirements to deliver customer value.
  • You see communication as one of your strengths.
  • You want to build and own your work end-to-end.
  • You are eager to move fast but recognize when to build for the future.

At Carta, you’re not just an employee. You’re a builder who is creatinginfrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. Cartans are helpful, relentless, unconventional, and kind; representing Carta’s Identity Traits. They work collaboratively and cross-functionallyto challenge the status quo, working towards a common goal of creating more owners in the private markets.

Disclosures

title: Especialista de Segurança Cibernética
description:
Resumo

Cria, revisa e implementa políticas, normas e procedimentos de segurança da informação para garantir a proteção dos dados e o cumprimento de normas e regulamentos. Desenvolve diretrizes de segurança para o uso seguro de redes, sistemas e aplicações. Realiza análise de riscos de segurança, identificando ameaças, vulnerabilidades e impactos potenciais para a organização. Propõe e implementa controles de segurança que mitigam os riscos identificados. Realiza avaliações regulares de risco em novos sistemas, aplicativos e atualizações de software. Monitora constantemente os sistemas de TI para identificar atividades suspeitas ou não autorizadas. Implementa e monitora sistemas de detecção de intrusão (IDS) e sistemas de prevenção de intrusão (IPS). Lidera e coordena respostas a incidentes de segurança cibernética, como violações de dados, malware, ransomware e outros tipos de ataques. Investiga incidentes, identifica a causa raiz e recomenda ações corretivas. Cria relatórios pós-incidente e desenvolve estratégias de prevenção para evitar futuras ocorrências. Conduz avaliações regulares de vulnerabilidade e testes de penetração (pentesting) para identificar fraquezas nos sistemas. Gerencia e prioriza a correção de vulnerabilidades por meio da aplicação de patches e atualizações de segurança. Gerencia e monitora sistemas de controle de acesso, assegurando que os usuários tenham apenas os privilégios necessários para realizar suas funções. Implementa e administra soluções de autenticação multifator (MFA) e sistemas de gerenciamento de identidades. Participa do desenvolvimento, manutenção e exercícios do Plano de Continuidade de Negócios e Plano de Recuperação de Desastres para garantir a continuidade das operações em caso de incidentes. Seleciona, especifica, configura e mantém ferramentas e tecnologias de segurança, como firewalls, antivírus, VPNs, sistemas de proteção de endpoints, DLP (Data Loss Prevention) e outros.

Requisitos

  • Experiência em Design de Arquitetura de Segurança;
  • Experiência em Monitoramento e Resposta a Incidentes;
  • Experiência em Teste de intrusão;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Segurança de Redes, Segurança de Aplicações e Segurança em Cloud;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Criptografia, Gestão de Identidade e Acesso (IAM).

Formação

Superior Completo em Sistemas de Informação, Gestão de Tecnologia da Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas afins.

Carta is a platform that helps people manage equity, build businesses, and invest in the companies of tomorrow. Our mission is to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You’ll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

As an Implementations Accountant, you will focus efforts on supporting new Fund Administration customers in their journey into Carta services.   • Resolving escalations related to data migration, historical accounting discrepancies, and client onboarding issues
  • Manage all aspects of customer onboarding for medium to high complexity new clients by managing timelines, setting clear customer expectations, and completing all compliance procedures pre go-live
  • Build strong client relationships and provide a white glove experience by going on-site, anticipating client needs, and using Carta app capabilities effectively
  • Identify process and quality improvements, assist with internal reviews, Quality Assurance, and train junior team members
  • Sharing accounting and onboarding specificities with upstream teams for efficient post go-live fund administration

Our implementation accounting team acts as the bridge between sales and long term account management for new fund clients. Ours is a team of folks who have mastery of accounting, exhibit a high degree of problem-solving, efficiency, and integrity as they leverage their subject-matter expertise to provide customers with a world-class onboarding experience.

About You

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of experience in an accounting role where you executed all aspects of end of quarter and year closes, preferably working within the Venture Capital Fund Administration environment
  • Strong accounting analysis skills with the ability to interpret a story through multiple years of unstructured data, and reproduce Financial Statements correctly
  • Ability to build strong client relationships through transparent and forthright communication. Able to manage multiple clients while hitting deadlines and providing white-glove service
  • Passionate about growing and advancing with Carta
  • Proven internal influencer having implemented and successfully managed both small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously

Salary

Carta’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, exceptional benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans. Our minimum cash compensation (salary + commission if applicable) range for this role is:

  • $102,000 - $120,000 in San Francisco, CA, Santa Clara, CA, and New York, NY

description:
Moffatt & Nichol specializes in large complex waterfront infrastructure projects and is recognized as one of the worldwide leaders in this field. The Rio de Janeiro Office is searching for a Civil Engineer, preferably with a Master’s Degree in Structural engineering, with 2 to 4 years’ industry experience to perform design services. The ideal candidate should have worked as an intern/co-op or structural engineer in a team environment participating in the production and development of structural concepts, analysis and calculations, construction drawings, services and material specifications, construction support services, and field inspections.

About Moffatt & Nichol

Moffatt & Nichol is a leading infrastructure advisor specialising in the planning and design of facilities that shape and serve our coastlines. Reflecting Moffatt & Nichol’s commitment to design innovation since 1945, Engineering News-Record (ENR) has ranked the company No. 1 design firm for Marine and Port Facilities in the United States and No. 7 internationally.

Moffatt & Nichol's professional staff includes engineers, planners, scientists, and architects who serve our global client base from offices in Europe, the Americas, the Middle East and Asia Pacific. The firm provides clients worldwide with customised service and a level of excellence that have become the firm’s hallmark in three primary practise areas—coastal, environmental, and water resources; ports and harbours; and transportation, bridges, and rail.

Duties and responsibilities

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

  • Development of structural analysis, design and detailing of concrete, steel, and timber structures
  • Finite element static and dynamic structural modeling and analysis of structures
  • Assist Senior Engineers with the preparation of design concepts, specifications, schedules, quantity and cost estimates
  • Prepare design calculations and check calculations
  • Coordinate detailed plan details with engineers and drafting technicians
  • Participate in field inspections, reports prepartions and in projects of rehabilitation of waterfront structures
  • Works in cooperation with other disciplines on multi-discipline projects

Other duties

Please note this job posting is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s of Science in Civil Engineering is required
  • Master’s of Science in Structural Engineering as a differential
  • Entry level with related internship experience or up to 2 years of industry experience
  • Civil engineer Licence CREA-RJ
  • Familiarity with either AutoCad / MicroStation, SAP2000 and REVIT as a differential
  • All new hires will be required to successfully complete and pass a pre-employment (post offer) background check in compliance with NIST 800-171

Please provide cover letter and resume when applying.

Working conditions

Sedentary for prolonged period of time, interact with clients, and travel occasionally.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades.

Nossa Cultura

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

  • Own It: Espírito de dono traz liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo que entregamos e buscamos evoluir o nosso negócio.
  • Live the Ride: Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com erros e vemos desafios como oportunidades de crescimento.
  • No Bullshit: Agimos com simplicidade. Somos práticos, sinceros e valorizamos feedbacks, usando transparência para evoluir, mesmo em erros.
  • Team Play: Quer ir rápido? Vá sozinho(a). Quer ir longe? Vá em equipe. Aprendemos uns com os outros, e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.
  • The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos impactá-lo positivamente e ver as melhorias que trazemos à sua vida.

A General Manager is responsible for managing the Hotel Executive team and overall hotel targets to deliver an excellent Guest and Member experience while managing profitability and guest satisfaction measures.


What will I be doing?

As a General Manager, you are responsible for managing the Hotel Executive team and overall hotel targets to deliver an excellent Guest and Member experience. A General Manager will also be required to manage profitability and guest satisfaction measures. Specifically, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:

  • Manage ongoing profitability of your hotel, ensuring revenue and guest satisfaction targets are met and exceeded
  • Lead in all key property issues including capital projects, customer service, and refurbishment
  • Ensure all decisions are made in the best interest of the hotels and Hilton
  • Deliver achievable hotel budgets, and set other short- and long- term strategic goals for the property
  • Provide effective leadership to hotel team members
  • Lead in all aspects of business planning
  • Comply with and exceed Hilton Brand Service Standards
  • Ensure costs are controlled and revenue opportunities are effectively sourced and delivered
  • Manage and develop the Hotel Executive team to ensure career progression and effective succession planning within Hilton
  • Hold regular briefings and communication meetings with the HOD team
  • Respond to audits to ensure continual improvement is achieved

What are we looking for?

A General Manager serving Hilton brands is always working on behalf of our Guests and working with other Team Members. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:

  • Experience as General Manager or Director of Operations within a similar quality hotel
  • Degree or diploma in Hotel Management or equivalent
  • Possesss strong commercial acumen, with experience in increasing profitability
  • Experience managing budgets, revenue proposals, and forecasting results in a similar sized property
  • Excellent leadership skills
  • Exceptional communication skills
  • In-depth knowledge of the hotel/leisure/service sector

It would be advantageous in this position for you to demonstrate the following capabilities and distinctions:

  • General Management experience in a similar quality hotel

What will it be like to work for Hilton?

Hilton is the leading global hospitality company, spanning the lodging sector from luxurious full-service hotels and resorts to extended-stay suites and mid-priced hotels. For nearly a century, Hilton has offered business and leisure travelers the finest in accommodations, service, amenities and value. Hilton is dedicated to continuing its tradition of providing exceptional guest experiences across its global brands . Our vision “to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality” unites us as a team to create remarkable hospitality experiences around the world every day. And, our amazing Team Members are at the heart of it all!

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

  • Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Tem perfil comercial, busca transição de carreira e quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance?

Conheça o XP Future - Rio de Janeiro, uma iniciativa disruptiva para profissionais com alto skill comercial e que desejam se tornar assessores de investimentos.

Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais que estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro.

Na XP Inc. você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira para que você se torne um profissional comercial de sucesso na corretora e tire a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor referência no mercado!

Se você já possui experiência comercial em outros segmentos e deseja fazer uma transição de carreira para o mercado financeiro, conheça os pré-requisitos para iniciar no XP Future logo abaixo!

  • Graduação superior completa ou estar cursando o último ano em período noturno;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente no Rio de Janeiro;
  • Experiência comercial (diferencial como Hunter - prospecção de novos negócios);
  • Curiosidade sobre o mundo dos investimentos;
  • Interesse por realizar uma transição de carreira;
  • Estar atuando em outros segmentos de mercado (Meios de pagamentos, adquirência, bebidas, fintechs, etc);
  • Não ser um Assessor de Investimentos ou Agente Autônomo (AAI)

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro)

Desafios e Impacto

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter uma alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial.

Obs.: a contratação é CLT.

Essa vaga é destinada a um pool de rede de talentos a nível Brasil, então pode ser que o retorno demore um pouco a mais do que outras vagas da XP! Em paralelo, também estão abertas as vagas dos XDays XP Future (vagas que acontecerão processos seletivos presenciais na cidade divulgada) para você se aplicar!

Triagem inicial : Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.

description:
Strategy & Operations Senior Analyst (Performance)

Rio de Janeiro - Brazil

About the company

If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.

We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don\'t even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).

To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.

Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.

About the team/role

We are looking for talented professionals to join our Regional Operations team at 99Food ! This is an exciting opportunity for individuals who are highly analytical, data-driven, and eager to solve complex business challenges at the city level. If you have a start-up spirit and are always looking to create value, you would be a great fit for this team!

As part of Regional Operations , selected candidates will play a key role in driving city growth, improving marketplace performance, and shaping local strategies that connect users, restaurants, and couriers. This role requires a hands-on approach, strong problem-solving skills, and a proactive mindset to identify opportunities for growth, efficiency, and differentiation.

The ideal candidates will engage directly with restaurant partners, customers, and business development teams to understand the dynamics of each city. They will analyze local performance data, gather on-the-ground perspectives, and translate insights into actionable strategies that strengthen 99Food’s position in each market and ensure long-term sustainable growth.

In this role, you\'ll be...

As a Strategy & Operations Senior Analyst at 99Food, you will be responsible for monitoring and analyzing the performance of our marketplace, growth campaigns, and communication initiatives . Your role is critical in ensuring that strategies are not only well-designed but also effectively executed and continuously optimized.

You will take ownership of building and maintaining performance dashboards, identifying key trends, and uncovering improvement opportunities across cities. By translating data into actionable insights, you will support decision-making and help guide campaign strategy, restaurant engagement, and customer growth.

This position requires a professional who is highly analytical, detail-oriented, and structured , with strong communication skills to collaborate across Operations, Marketing, CRM, Product, and BD teams. You will act as the bridge between strategy and execution , ensuring that every initiative is measured, tracked, and improved to maximize its impact.

Your work will directly contribute to shaping how 99Food grows and strengthens its position in competitive markets, driving both short-term results and long-term expansion .

We\'re eager to be in touch because you have...

  • General Requirements
    • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Statistics, Business Administration, Economics, or related fields.
    • 2–5 years of experience in data analytics, operations, strategy, or growth-related roles.
    • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
    • Advanced Excel, SQL, and data analytics skills (Python/R knowledge is a plus, but not required).
  • Performance Management
    • Experience with campaign results analysis, including performance tracking, communication effectiveness, and financial tracking.
    • Prior experience with customer-related activities (e.g., campaign management, communication strategy, customer cohort analysis, market analysis, budget management, etc.).
    • Stakeholder and project management experience, with exposure to Operations, Product, Sales/BD, and Marketing/CRM.
    • Fluency in Portuguese and English; Mandarin is a strong plus.

You\'ll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value. We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven. We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration. Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone\'s best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity. Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth. We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion. Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a vision of the future or something we wish to have one day, it is a non-negotiable value of who we are.

We practice inclusion, plurality, and respect. And we count on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works together with HR, leadership and identity groups - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres, and 99Mamães. This part of our journey has been written, there remains a long road before us.

We reinforce that this position is open to everyone, including pregnant people and people with disabilities (PwD).

Esse papel exige por uma pessoa ambiciosa. Você representará uma função crítica em nossas operações de transporte mais amplas na Amazon, enquanto trabalhamos para melhorar continuamente os níveis de serviço, prezando pela segurança em nossas instalações. Isso nos ajudará a garantir que as promessas feitas aos nossos valiosos clientes sejam cumpridas sempre.
Uma pessoa especialista em operações de transporte facilita o fluxo de informações entre diferentes partes interessadas (transportadoras/hubs/armazéns) e resolve quaisquer possíveis problemas que afetem a experiência do cliente e a continuidade dos negócios. Além disso, trabalhará em operações externas com relacionamento Sort Center/Carrier, garantindo que o caminhão saia do SC para entregar os pedidos dos clientes conforme a promessa. Essa pessoa também monitora a chegada da nossa frota e aborda quaisquer possíveis problemas que ocorram durante o ciclo de vida do frete saindo do FC/SC e chegando às instalações do cliente.
Como especialista em transporte, você deve ser capaz de solucionar o problema em tempo hábil pesquisando e consultando ferramentas internas e tomando decisões em tempo real. Você deve ser capaz de entender os requisitos/ser capaz de analisar dados e observar tendências e ser capaz de impulsionar a experiência do cliente sem comprometer o tempo. Ter o conhecimento básico de Logística e deve ser capaz de se comunicar claramente na forma escrita e oral, também é necessário. A pessoa deve ser capaz de idealizar melhorias no processo e ter o zelo de levá-las à conclusão.
Nossa cultura inclusiva capacita os amazonians a oferecer os melhores resultados para nossos clientes. Não só celebramos a diversidade de nossa força de trabalho, mas também as diversas formas de trabalhar. Se você quiser solicitar uma acomodação para o processo de entrevista ou integração, informe nossa equipe e nós o conectaremos à nossa equipe de acomodação.
Essa função funcionará em turnos 3x2 das 18h às 5h
Key job responsibilities
Comunicação com clientes externos (transportadoras, fornecedores/fornecedores) e clientes internos (varejo, finanças, suporte de software, centros de atendimento, estações de entrega, centros de classificação).
Capacidade de extrair dados de vários bancos de dados (usando Excel, Access, SQL e/ou outros sistemas de gerenciamento de dados) e realizar relatórios e análises ad hoc conforme necessário é uma vantagem.
Desenvolver e/ou compreender métricas de desempenho para ajudar a impulsionar os resultados comerciais.
Deve ser capaz de entender rapidamente o impacto comercial das tendências e tomar decisões que façam sentido com base nos dados disponíveis.
Deve ser capaz de encaminhar sistematicamente problemas ou variações nas informações e dados para os proprietários e equipes relevantes e cumprir as resoluções para garantir que sejam entregues.
Trabalhe dentro de várias restrições de tempo para atender às necessidades críticas dos negócios, ao mesmo tempo em que mede e identifica as atividades realizadas.
Excelente comunicação, tanto verbal quanto escrita, para criar uma narrativa descrevendo as descobertas semanais e as variações das metas, e apresentá-las em um fórum de revisão.
Suporta o monitoramento da chegada de veículos, correta alocação de veículos no horário necessário para carregamento, nas docas corretas, respeitando todos os padrões de segurança Amazon.
Responder às atividades de agendamento de veículos.

O Ops Lead é o principal ponto de contato de transportes dentro de um centro de distribuição/ sort center. Garantirá a execução da rotina e a exelência nos resultados das métricas. Analisará qualquer desvio, mesmo que pequeno, para evitar problemas de qualidade e segurança. Escalará pontenciais riscos de atendimento para a liderança, e garantirá o fluxo de entrada e saída de veículos sem gargalos.

This role is pivotal in maintaining strong supplier relationships, overseeing risk and compliance processes, and supporting procurement and security initiatives across the business.
The post holder will work alongside global colleagues in supporting the business and would be expected to work across multiple time zones, on a per-project basis. This position provides exposure to a broad range of IT-related projects and activities, and new technology introductions to the business.
Principle Accountabilities:
Vendor & Supplier Management
  • Manage relationships with third-party vendors delivering core IT solutions to Airswift.
  • Oversee the supplier onboarding process.
  • Ensure vendor compliance with contractual obligations and agreed SLAs.
  • Collaborate with suppliers to identify cost savings and eliminate inefficiencies.
  • Proactively monitor contract expiry dates to ensure timely re-negotiation and renewals.
  • Developing and implementing streamlined procurement processes for technology expenditure, ensuring consistent management of both new and renewal spending.
  • Track and analyze supplier performance using Excel and dashboard reporting tools.
  • Working in collaboration with the Quality Dept, provide regular ISMS performance reports for the Group IT Director and other stakeholders.
  • Monitor user access and IT licenses, ensuring timely deactivation of unused accounts.
IT Risk & Compliance
  • Oversee the IT Risk Management process.Including maintaining the Risk Register, coordinating Risk Review meetings, and monitoring risk treatment plans to ensure that these are deployed by the Risk Owners in a timely manner.
  • Identify and escalate potential risks in service delivery, performance, or spending that may impact IT or the wider business.
  • Lead the implementation and maintenance of policies and procedures aligned with ISO27001 standards.

Procurement & Budget Management

  • Support the development and implementation of streamlined procurement processes for IT expenditure.
  • Manage supplier costs in line with the IT budget and ensure transparency for cross-charging business units for usage.
  • Handle contract renewals for key IT services, ensuring cost-effective and aligned solutions.

Security & Awareness

  • Assist the Bids team with security questionnaires and compliance documentation.
  • Lead internal security awareness initiatives, including phishing campaigns and “Did You Know?” updates.
  • Lead the implementation and maintenance of relevant policies and standard operating procedures in line with ISO27001 requirements.
  • Develop and maintain training materials for the Information Security Management System (ISMS) and requirements of ISO27001.

Innovation & Collaboration

  • Work closely with internal stakeholders to promote innovation within the technology ecosystem.
  • Communicate relevant technology and security updates to the business to drive adoption and best practices.
  • Collaborate with the Quality Dept on matters relating to ISO27001 compliance and opportunities for improvement, such as those identified through internal audits.

Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:

  • Proven experience in IT administration, vendor management, or procurement support.
  • Strong understanding of IT compliance frameworks, particularly ISO27001 would be ideal.
  • Proficiency in Excel and dashboard reporting tools.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Analytical mindset with a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Experience with contract negotiation and supplier onboarding is a plus.

What we can offer you!

  • Attractive monthly base salary + performance bonus.
  • Genuine career progression opportunities, either locally or globally!
  • World-class training programmes and development opportunities.
  • Virtual Onboarding Events exclusively for new hires.
  • Team driven environment, supportive culture with a focus on work-life balance.
  • Career breaks available after one year.
  • Real time recognition through our employee reward platform.
  • Mental Health First Aiders to signpost you to support when you need it.
  • Yearly destination trips as part of our High Flyers program (Dubai, Buenos Aires, etc…)
  • Charity days for various important causes, such as Relay for Life and Earth Day.

Senior Software Engineer, Fund Operations

The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. As a Senior Software Engineer I or Senior Software Engineer II , you’ll work to solve problems like:

  • How can we leverage the power of AI to create exceptional, seamless experiences for our customers?
  • How can we design reliable systems for tracking capital movement across a fund’s lifecycle, from initial call to final distribution?
  • How do we build flexible reporting pipelines that adapt to evolving fund structures and support compliance with financial regulations?
  • How can we apply machine learning to automate workflows traditionally powered by spreadsheets and manual reviews?

The Team You’ll Work With

Carta’s Fund Operations Engineering Organization is designing the infrastructure that redefines how investment firms across Venture Capital and Private Equity run. We’re building the systems that sit at the heart of fund administration: financial data pipelines, transaction engines, ML-assisted tooling, and full-service automation.

Our teams are multidisciplinary, working closely with product leaders, accountants, data scientists, and ML researchers to take on some of Carta’s most challenging, ambiguous problems. We’re drawn to complexity, motivated by clarity, and operate with a high degree of ownership. If you thrive in early innings problems, enjoy building clean abstractions from messy, real-world scenarios, and want to help shape an industry-standard platform from the ground up, this is the place to do it.

About You

At Carta, you’re not just an employee. You’re a builder who is creating infrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. Cartans are helpful, relentless, unconventional and kind; representing Carta’s Identity Traits. They work collaboratively and cross functionally to challenge the status quo; working towards a common goal of creating more owners in the private markets.

  • You have 6+ years of experience of full-stack or backend engineering experience
  • You have strong technical skills and are an excellent collaborator
  • You act as an owner, not just a contributor, by taking responsibility for outcomes, pushing through ambiguity, and championing solutions that improve team efficiency and business impact.
  • You implement systems that are clear, maintainable, and stand the test of time.
  • You are excited by opportunities to both break ground on new projects and provide fresh perspective onto past implementations.
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.

  • Definir KPIs de sucesso e analisar relatórios de efetividade das estratégias (KPI's estratégicos) e KPIs operacionais (KPI's táticos);
  • Monitorar resultados dos experimentos de CRO (Optimize).

Conhecimento, Experiência e Formação

  • Conhecimento em atualização de plataformas digitais;
  • Experiência com CRM;
  • Conhecimento de metodologias de testes A/B;
  • Conhecimento em Marketing Digital;
  • Obrigatório Superior completo, preferencialmente em Administração, Comunicação e Marketing.

A fim de construir um time dedicado a revolucionar o padrão de relacionamento com o cliente, buscamos profissionais apaixonados e empreendedores, prontos para desafiar o status quo e oferecer uma experiência com um diferencial competitivo no mercado.

Como é ser um Líder de Equipe de Consultores Comerciais Internos?

Você será responsável pelo time de consultores Stone que possui como missão atuar de forma estratégica para construção do relacionamento com o cliente, a fim de reter, rentabilizar e impulsionar o empreendimento da sua carteira. Além disso, entre as suas atribuições estão:

  • Ter experiência com indicadores comerciais como Churn, TPV e ROI
  • Ensino Superior Cursando ou Completo;
  • Comunicação clara e efetiva;
  • Foco em resultados, priorizando o alcance das metas.

5x2 - segunda à sexta de 08h às 17h | Híbrido - Escritório Passeio, Rio de Janeiro

Overview

Analista Comercial - Inside Sales (Outbound) com foco em prospecção ativa, presencial no Rio de Janeiro. Vaga exclusiva para Pessoas com Deficiência (PcD).

A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros orientada ao cliente, com atuação na transformação da indústria de pagamentos e foco em resultados para empreendedores brasileiros.

A cultura da Stone valoriza inclusão, autonomia, parceria e melhoria contínua, guiada por pilares que estimulam desempenho com responsabilidade social e foco no cliente.

A missão é conquistar novos clientes de forma ativa e consultiva através do canal telefônico, oferecendo as melhores experiências aos clientes. O time de Outbound está em expansão com o objetivo de aumentar a base de clientes.

Como é ser um Analista Comercial de Inside Sales no time de Outbound, no apresentado contexto, envolve conhecer o negócio e os produtos para realizar vendas ativas por meio de uma ferramenta de discagem automática, diagnosticando necessidades e conectando-as às soluções financeiras.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Atender as ligações realizadas pela discagem automática;
  • Diagnosticar a necessidade do cliente e conectar nossas soluções para o fechamento da venda;
  • Manter boa organização dos clientes em negociação e realizar follow-up;
  • Gerar propostas no sistema e assegurar a entrega da melhor proposta, acompanhando até o fechamento;
  • Acompanhar resultados individuais e do time por meio de dashboards e reuniões.

O que aumenta suas chances

  • Conhecimento em gestão de funil de vendas;

description:
About Us

Airswift is the leading workforce solutions provider to the STEM industries. For over 40 years Airswift has been transforming lives through the provision of international workforce solutions to STEM industries. Today, we are an integrated team of over 900 employees across 37 countries, supporting over 8,000 contractors globally.

We are a people business – we transform lives through the world of work. We care about wellbeing, community engagement and our planet – we plant a tree for every person placed in a job globally! We have a passion for growth, including investing in the development of our people.

We support professionals looking for jobs with exceptional firms in the technology, construction, and engineering sectors.

Role Description

The Quality Control Team play a critical role in maintaining data quality across the business. Data is at the core of our operations, and it is essential that this data is of a high standard at all times. The QC Analyst will work as part of the Commercial Team to drive data accuracy across the region, as well as being a part of the Global QC Team, sharing best practices, improvement initiatives and maintaining consistency across all regions. Attention to detail is paramount and strong communication skills are essential as there will be significant collaboration with other departments, in particular with the Recruitment and Service Teams.

Principle Accountabilities:

  • Review Bullhorn records within the agreed timeframes and issue approval or query notes as appropriate. This may include Contract Placements, Change Requests, Perm/Direct Hire placements, GEM Placements, Client Records, Opportunity Records and Requirement Records.
  • Work with the relevant parties to ensure that any errors are corrected in a timely manner.
  • Produce reporting and analysis to provide key stakeholders with an accurate and up to date view of data accuracy across the region.
  • Hold regular QC review meetings with relevant departments to discuss any issues and identify key areas for improvement.
  • Collaborate with other QC Coordinators, both regionally and globally, to share best practices and drive process improvement, in particular to deal with interregional placements efficiently.
  • Take a proactive approach to data clean-up e.g., updating fields in Bullhorn when a staff member leaves
  • Support the QA/PIs with QC related process improvement projects
  • Special adhoc projects, as directed by the Commercial Operations Manager
  • Liaise closely with Payroll & Billing to ensure contract compliance relating to payroll and invoicing
  • Work closely with Sales Team to ensure quality and contract compliance
  • Ensure that Bullhorn and any relevant trackers are updated accordingly

Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:

  • Fluent English
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • Excellent technical skills including all Microsoft Office products
  • Strong numerical skills
  • Ability to problem solve
  • Attention to detail
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to make decisions and prioritise objectives
  • Must be a self-starter and able to work without supervision
  • Able to handle demanding situations

What we can offer you!

  • Attractive monthly base salary + competitive commission/performance bonus.
  • Genuine career progression opportunities, either locally or globally!
  • World-class training programmes and development opportunities.
  • Virtual Onboarding Events exclusively for new hires.
  • Team driven environment, supportive culture with a focus on work-life balance.
  • Career breaks available after one year.
  • Real time recognition through our employee reward platform.
  • Mental Health First Aiders to signpost you to support when you need it.
  • Yearly destination trips as part of our High Flyers program (Dubai, Buenos Aires, etc…)
  • Charity days for various important causes such as Relay for Life and Earth Day.

Our Core Values:

  • Growth - In life and business, one must grow to flourish and achieve high ambitions. Growth requires change, challenge, risk and sacrifice - we will always choose growth.
  • Life – Above all else, we value life. The quality of life, both in and outside of work, profoundly influences our well-being and our impact on the world.
  • Excellence - We deliver, holding ourselves accountable for results. Our customers see excellence in everything we do.
  • Integrity - We are ethical, open, honest and authentic. People trust us to do the right thing for the right reason.

Desde 1948, a Andrade Gutierrez vem ajudando a construir e a desenvolver o Brasil. Desde então, a empresa tem participado de algumas das obras mais importantes da história de nosso país. Construímos o desenvolvimento de uma sociedade e inovamos todos os dias na forma de pensar e de fazer engenharia.

A Andrade Gutierrez se destaca como uma das maiores empresas de engenharia da América Latina e nossa trajetória tem sido marcada pela busca por novas oportunidades e grandes desafios.

Nosso desenvolvimento acontece de forma sustentável e está apoiado em pilares como qualidade, responsabilidade socioambiental e segurança no trabalho. Nossas unidades de engenharia e construção são focadas em projetos de Infraestrutura, Energia, Mobilidade e Indústria, com ênfase na excelência operacional.

Resumo do Cargo:

Responsável por executar e analisar projetos, recursos necessários e outras exigências, a fim de atender às necessidades para execução do projeto, bem como apoiar no cumprimento do cronograma da obra atentando para otimização de custos, qualidade e produtividade dos serviços prestados e das sequências executivas da obra.

  • Controlar e consolidar as medições mensais (contrato global e unitário), com as devidas evidências fotográficas e documentais, garantindo que todos os serviços executados sejam corretamente registrados e validados;
  • Garantir que as medições estejam em total conformidade com os critérios contratuais, assegurando o reconhecimento e o recebimento das receitas da empresa;
  • Analisar e conferir quantitativos de serviços realizados em campo, alinhando com engenharia, planejamento e equipes de produção;
  • Coletar, organizar e validar as evidências de medição, mantendo um relatório robusto e detalhado, com foco na rastreabilidade e na precisão dos dados;
  • Preparar relatórios de avanço físico-financeiro, assegurando a correta formalização junto ao cliente;
  • Apoiar a gestão contratual em pleitos, reequilíbrios e tratativas de glosas;
  • Atuar como elo entre execução, planejamento, custos e cliente, garantindo que o avanço físico seja refletido no fluxo de caixa do contrato.
  • Formação superior em Engenharia;
  • Experiência em Administração Contratual com contratos globais preferencialmente em obras de grande porte EPC;
  • Domínio em processos de medição (serviços globais e unitários);
  • Conhecimento em análise de projetos, controle de quantitativos e acompanhamento de campo;
  • Capacidade de interpretação e aplicação de cláusulas contratuais;
  • Habilidade em elaboração de relatórios técnicos e gerenciais;
  • Boa comunicação para interação com cliente, engenharia e áreas internas;

É com a força da #NossaGente que construímos o futuro e chegamos cada vez mais longe!

A Andrade Gutierrez nasceu em 1948 em Minas Gerais, do sonho de três jovens engenheiros que começaram a abrir estradas e desde então não pararam mais. A empresa atuou e atua em alguns dos projetos mais importantes do país e do mundo. Estamos presentes nos setores de infraestrutura, mobilidade urbana, mineração, energia, óleo e gás.

Sempre à frente do seu setor, e alinhada às melhores práticas, a Andrade Gutierrez criou, em 2018, o Vetor AG: primeiro programa de inovação aberta do setor de Engenharia e Construção, responsável por fazer o mapeamento e conexão dos desafios da AG com soluções inovadoras do mercado. LATAM Digital PR Specialist at Better Collective

Job Description

Hey there, Future LATAM Digital PR Specialist at Better Collective! Our Mission is to be the world’s leading digital sports media company, making sports entertainment more engaging and transparent for fans worldwide. At Better Collective, we're the team behind industry-leading brands like Bolavip Brasil, Bolavip Argentina, SomosFanaticos, Action Network, HLTV. We're looking for a new member to join the team who is responsible for boosting Better Collective’s brand awareness across its owned digital properties. Specifically, you will be responsible for ideating, creating, implementing, and reporting on digital public relations campaigns with the goal of acquiring high-value backlinks to Better Collective websites.

How You'll Make an Impact

Here are some of the ways you’ll contribute to our mission:

  • Ideate and create PR campaigns to increase brand awareness and generate high-quality backlinks across Better Collective brands: Bolavip Brasil, Bolavip Argentina, Action Network and VegasInsider.
  • Write texts in journalistic format in Spanish
  • Support the South American Team Lead as needed
  • Stay “in-tune” with the world of sports to identify and capitalize on breaking news and trends to ensure that BC stays ahead of the competition
  • Work across SEO, content, and design teams to ensure quality deliverables
  • Track and report on individual PR campaigns to showcase their effectiveness in acquiring backlinks to BC sites
  • Use tools such as Muck Rack or Comunique-se to build an outreach contact list of journalists, media sites, bloggers, and other relevant parties to secure campaign pitch opportunities
  • Write relevant and entertaining content to be pitched to third parties for link building purposes
  • Provide regular topic recommendations for new digital PR campaigns based on industry and competitive research

Job requirements

The Ideal Profile: Is This You? Here’s what helps people succeed in this role:

  • At least 1.5-3 years of experience in PR or Digital PR - either in an agency or in-house environment;
  • Experience of executing PR or Digital PR across LATAM;
  • Experience of different PR or Digital PR campaign types - from reactive to hero campaigns;
  • A strong passion for sports and digital public relations & communications;
  • Data-driven mindset to utilize trends and campaign results to inform future decisions;
  • Strong written and verbal communication;
  • Ability to work across multiple teams and digital brands;
  • Basic understanding of SEO and Content Marketing best practices, and what the core principles of PR and Digital PR are;
  • Passionate about staying up to date on trends and relevant stories across the sports and wider news world;
  • Self-motivation, strong organizational skills, and flexibility are required to be effective in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment of digital marketing and SEO;
  • Intermediate or higher level of English proficiency;
  • Intermediate or higher level of Spanish proficiency.

With 375 rooms and suites, many offering panoramic views of the ocean and Sugar Loaf Mountain, the hotel blends timeless elegance with the vibrant energy of Rio.

As a leading destination for both leisure and business travelers, the hotel boasts extensive meeting and event spaces, hosting everything from high-profile international conferences to glamorous weddings and social gatherings. Job Description

As the General Manager of Fairmont Copacabana, you will embody the essence of luxury hospitality. Your dynamic and hands-on approach is fueled by a deep passion for developing people and fostering an entrepreneurial spirit. A true brand and guest ambassador, you will challenge conventions, consistently seek solutions, and infuse innovation into every facet of the hotel experience and every function of the business.

Your seasoned leadership style will blend diplomacy with relationship-building prowess, cultivating strong connections with both internal and external stakeholders, including Owners and the Community. Your ability to engage with ownership and strategize revenue enhancements will be coupled with an innate talent for envisioning the hotel\'s long-term trajectory.

In your role as a catalyst for exceptional service, you will uphold the highest standards, infusing every interaction with the kind of genuine care that leaves an indelible mark on our guests. Nurturing an environment of continuous growth and skill development, you will inspire our colleagues to consistently exceed expectations, turning moments into memories for every visitor.

As a visionary leader, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our strategic direction. Your involvement in goal setting and objective communication will propel business growth and solidify the hotel’s reputation as a distinguished luxury destination. Your ability to foster positive relationships with ownership will ensure a harmonious partnership that aligns with our overarching strategy while enhancing the hotel's performance and prestige.

Your leadership will be synonymous with setting industry benchmarks and redefining luxury hospitality. Your commitment to excellence, coupled with your innovative approach, will leave an enduring mark on our iconic brand and create a legacy of unparalleled guest memories.

Demonstrate explicit knowledge and awareness of company standards as an integral role model. Build quality relationships with the management team. Create an environment that encourages innovation, challenges traditional thinking, and fosters a "speak-up" culture.

  • 2. Create positive impact working with others: Foster an inclusive and collaborative work environment, empowering colleagues to contribute their best and building strong relationships based on trust and respect. Create a collaborative and inclusive environment where all colleagues are encouraged to provide input. Actively listen to team members' ideas, concerns, and feedback and incorporate their input into decision-making processes. Recognize and appreciate the contributions and well-being of colleagues.

  • 3. Strive for guest/client satisfaction: Exhibits a deep understanding of the luxury hospitality landscape and guest expectations, ensuring that the guest experience consistently exceeds industry standards. Maintain product and service quality standards by conducting ongoing evaluations. Handle VIP Guests and understand international protocols for government officials and royalty. Monitor guest/client feedback, address concerns promptly, and implement improvements to optimize satisfaction.

  • 4. Consistently deliver excellence: Demonstrates a comprehensive understanding of ownership group's investment objectives and formulates strategic business plans that align with those objectives; ensuring preservation and maximization of the hotel’s assets. Set high performance standards, lead by example, and drive a culture of continuous improvement and quality across all the hotel. Exhibits expertise in sales, marketing, and revenue management, driving the hotel's performance in the luxury hospitality market. Maximize financial performance, control costs, and execute marketing and operational activities that produce results meeting or exceeding the hotel's business plan. Recognize and reward outstanding performance and celebrate achievements within the organization.

  • 5. Enable team success: Support the professional growth and development of colleagues through coaching, mentoring, and providing opportunities for learning. Encourage individuals to take on challenging assignments and stretch their capabilities. Provide regular feedback and guidance, recognizing achievements and offering constructive suggestions for improvement. Create a safe and empowering environment where individuals feel comfortable taking risks, expressing their ideas, and learning from failures. As applicable, bring experience in working with labor unions, maintaining constructive relationships and ensuring harmonious teamwork.

  • 6. Create clarity: Articulates a clear and comprehensive vision for the hotel, aligning goals and objectives with ownership group's investment strategy. Effectively communicates organizational vision, goals, and expectations, fostering a shared sense of purpose and direction among team members. Demonstrates adeptness in overseeing renovation projects, maintaining transparency and open communication throughout the process. Addresses ambiguity and navigates complex situations with transparency, fostering an environment of clear direction and effective problem-solving.

  • 7. Inspire for top performance: Lead with passion and integrity, motivate and inspire others to achieve their best. Market plans and ideas successfully, reducing key and complex ideas and messages to clear, memorable, and compelling statements. Embodies an entrepreneurial spirit, inspiring innovative thinking and fostering a culture that encourages taking calculated risks. Recognizes and rewards outstanding performance, cultivating an atmosphere of achievement and recognition. Promotes continuous development and growth, offering resources and guidance to nurture professional skills and talents. Champions a "speak-up" culture, creating an environment where diverse opinions are valued, and individual contributions are celebrated. Convince others, negotiate, debate, and find win-win solutions.

Qualifications

  • Strong people skills and a track record of fostering positive, inclusive, high-performing cultures.

  • Strategic thinker with excellent communication and presentation skills.

  • Displays a strong entrepreneurial spirit

  • Bottom-line oriented with a focus on quality guest service and team-building.

  • Creative and innovative mindset.

  • Ability to collaborate and work in a fast-paced environment.

  • Professional demeanor and strategic orientation.

Se você é apaixonado pelo bem-estar e busca uma carreira com propósito, nossas oportunidades são para você!

O QUE BUSCAMOS? Profissionais com formação na área de saúde e bem estar, que acreditam em seu trabalho como um motor de transformação.

Responsabilidade Terapeuta Nossos(as) Terapeutas são responsáveis por executar protocolos de terapias corporais e faciais exclusivos da rede Buddha Spa descritos no menu de serviços tais como massagens relaxantes, shiatsu, drenagem, modeladora, limpeza de pele, massagem desportiva, ayurvédica, entre outras.

  • Esperamos que você tenha Formação nas áreas de Massoterapia, Fisioterapia, Estética, Naturologia, Naturopatia, Terapias Integrativas, Biomedicina, Enfermagem, Educação Física, Farmácia, somente com pós em Estética. O que oferecemos Ao ingressar na rede Buddha Spa, o profissional técnico passa por um importante processo de imersão, treinamento e preparação para estar apto a atuar no padrão de excelência da marca. Estas etapas envolvem:

  • Apresentação de boas-vindas e introdução ao mercado de bem-estar;
  • 104 horas de treinamento inicial de padronização e direcionamento nos protocolos técnicos, rituais de atendimento, treinamentos sobre produtos utilizados na experiência do cliente e direcionamento estratégico dos atendimentos em um centro de treinamento renomado Buddha College;
  • Vivência de aprendizado e aperfeiçoamento prático em unidade Buddha Spa;
  • Atualizações e treinamentos semanais através de plataforma EAD, com dicas, orientações de atendimento e tira dúvidas com a equipe de coordenação técnica da franqueadora;
  • Acesso a conteúdo permanente de treinamento e desenvolvimento em rede social corporativa Buddha Spa.

O Buddha Spa reconhece e valoriza todos os profissionais técnicos e parceiros da rede. Periodicamente realizamos premiações de desempenho e reconhecimentos, com viagens, experiências, passeios, restaurantes e participação em eventos/campeonatos internacionais do setor.

Se você é movido(a) por um comprometimento com o bem-estar e deseja fazer parte da nossa história, essa vaga é para você!

title: Analista de Processos Sênior
description:
Que tal fazer parte do nosso time como Analista de Processos Sênior? Sua missão será realizar o mapeamento do fluxo de atividades através de entrevistas e análise de documentos e identificar gaps, estabelecendo estratégias para a solução de problemas e propondo a melhoria contínua dos processos.

Essa é uma oportunidade no modelo 100% presencial no Rio de Janeiro.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Como Analista de Processos Sênior, você focará em: levantar informações sobre os processos, analisando as etapas, os responsáveis, os recursos utilizados e os resultados desejados.
  • Desenhar processos relativos a áreas de negócio e também específicos de TI.
  • Elaborar descritivos detalhando as atividades de processos.
  • Elaborar documentos de requisitos de sistemas.
  • Realizar mapeamento de jornadas (ex.: clientes, colaboradores, etc).
  • Avaliar a eficiência e a eficácia dos processos atuais, identificando gargalos, falhas ou ineficiências.
  • Ministrar treinamentos para as equipes sobre novos processos ou práticas de trabalho.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Ensino superior em Engenharias, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Ampla experiência em análise e melhoria de processos.
  • Conhecimento em notações para modelagem de processos (BPMN, ARIS, EPC, entre outros).
  • Experiência no mapeamento de requisitos de sistema.
  • Experiência no mapeamento de jornadas.

description:
O Analista Jurídico atua como parceiro estratégico das áreas de negócio da DeLuna, prevenindo riscos e viabilizando operações logísticas com segurança jurídica, celeridade e eficiência. Garante a conformidade regulatória setorial, robustez contratual com clientes e parceiros, redução de passivos e suporte consultivo à expansão nacional, à transformação digital e ao avanço operacional.

OsRequisitos mínimos para a função são:

  • Bacharelado em Direito e OAB ativa.
  • Experiência sólida em direito empresarial/contratual e contencioso cível/trabalhista, com passagem por logística, transporte, e-commerce ou varejo com operação de distribuição.
  • Vivência com regulação do transporte (normas ANTT e correlatas), seguros de transporte (RCTR-C, RCF-DC) e gestão de sinistros.
  • Domínio de contratos B2B e atenção às regras de consumidor para B2C.
  • Noções práticas de LGPD aplicadas à logística e integração tecnológica.
  • Capacidade de negociação, escrita jurídica clara e orientação a negócios.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens pontuais.

Diferenciais desejáveis

  • Pós-graduação em Direito Empresarial, Contratos, Regulatório, Trabalhista ou Proteção de Dados.
  • Experiência com operações frigorificadas/cadeia fria e SLAs de temperatura.
  • Atuação prévia com RFPs/RFQs, licitações e contratos com marketplaces.
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado.
  • Vivência com Legal Tech, CLM e dashboards jurídicos (Power BI).

Competências comportamentais

  • Visão de negócio e mentalidade consultiva, com senso de urgência.
  • Comunicação clara e habilidade de mediação/negociação.
  • Proatividade, organização e gestão de prioridades em ambiente dinâmico.
  • Postura ética, confidencialidade e foco em compliance/ESG.
  • Colaboração com áreas multifuncionais (Operações, Comercial, Financeiro, Fiscal, RH, TI/SI).

Principais responsabilidades e atividades

1) Consultivo e Contratual

  • Elaborar, revisar e negociar contratos com clientes (embarcadores, marketplaces), fornecedores (transportadoras subcontratadas, operadores, armazéns, tecnologia) e parceiros estratégicos.
  • Padronizar minutas, SLAs, KPIs, níveis de serviço e penalidades, incluindo particularidades de:
    • Last Mile, Line Haul, cross-docking, pontos de trânsito (Transit Points) e XPts.
    • Operação de carga frigorificada (cadeia fria e controle de temperatura).
    • Entregas B2C/B2B (CDC e B2B), prazos, avarias, extravios e limitação de responsabilidade.
  • Revisar cláusulas de responsabilidade, seguro, sinistros, guarda e custódia, compliance, confidencialidade (NDA), anticorrupção, LGPD, propriedade intelectual, rescisão e mediação/arbitragem.
  • Suporte jurídico a RFPs/RFQs e licitações (públicas e privadas, incluindo pregões e contratos de adesão de marketplaces).

2) Regulação do Transporte e Compliance

  • Acompanhar e aplicar normas e resoluções vigentes da ANTT e demais órgãos competentes.
  • Orientar sobre CT-e, MDF-e, PGR (gerenciamento de riscos), tabelas de frete mínimo e documentação de transporte.
  • Suportar compliance ESG, anticorrupção (Lei 12.846/2013), concorrencial e trabalhista (incluindo particularidades do motorista profissional e relações com agregados/terceiros).
  • Implementar e atualizar políticas internas, treinar equipes (Operações, Comercial, Fiscal/Tributário, RH) e disseminar cultura de integridade.

3) LGPD e Segurança da Informação

  • Auxiliar a TI/Segurança na adequação LGPD (Lei 13.709/2018), especialmente em:
    • Base legal para rastreamento em tempo real, telemetria e geolocalização de motoristas.
    • Proteção de dados de clientes finais (B2C) e corporativos (B2B).
    • Contratos com operadores de dados, DPA, cláusulas de confidencialidade e retenção.
  • Apoiar resposta a incidentes de privacidade e demandas de titulares.

4) Contencioso, Pré-Contencioso e Recuperação de Crédito

  • Atuar (diretamente ou com escritórios externos) no contencioso cível, consumidor e trabalhista (estratégia, peças, audiências e acordos), priorizando soluções eficientes e redução de passivos.
  • Gerenciar carteira de processos (prazos, provisionamento, relatórios executivos) e padronizar defesas.
  • Atuar em sinistros de carga (avaria, roubo, extravio), abertura/gestão de sinistros com seguradoras e ações regressivas.
  • Coordenar cobrança e recuperação de crédito; estruturar acordos e garantias.

5) Tributário conectado ao Transporte (interface)

  • Interface com Fiscal/Tributário sobre ICMS no transporte, benefícios e obrigações acessórias correlatas a CT-e/MDF-e (sem substituir o especialista tributário).
  • Mitigar riscos de autuações vinculadas a operações logísticas e documentação fiscal de transporte.

6) Gestão de Terceiros e Due Diligence

  • Realizar due diligence jurídica de parceiros (transportadoras, armazéns, tecnologia), verificando regularidade, licenças, seguros (RCTR-C, RCF-DC) e compliance.
  • Manter cadastro jurídico atualizado e clausulados padrões para onboarding de parceiros.

7) Suporte a Expansão e Imobiliário/Facilities

  • Analisar contratos de locação/cessão de espaços logísticos, condomínio, utilities e obras de adequação.
  • Apoiar a expansão para novas praças, centros de distribuição e bases operacionais.

O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.
