Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

SOBRE O BANCO DE TALENTOS

A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Este é um banco de talentos para Psicopedagogo(a). Se você ama trabalhar como profissional dessa área, se comunica de forma clara e é uma pessoa proativa, não deixe de enviar seu currículo!

Como nosso Psicopedagogo(a), você cumpriria as seguintes atividades:

  • Adaptar materiais e atividades pedagógicas, em português e inglês, para alunos com transtornos de aprendizagem;
  • Ter e buscar conhecimento das dificuldades, habilidades e interesses dos alunos, para fundamentar as supervisões dos mediadores;
  • Demonstrar conhecimento de ferramentas, materiais e estratégias para auxiliar o trabalho dos mediadores sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Definir objetivos diferenciados para os alunos, a partir de avaliação de seus níveis de desenvolvimento real para que possam atingir níveis desejáveis de desenvolvimento;
  • Coordenar os mediadores quanto ao planejamento de atividades de avaliação coerentes com as necessidades e habilidades dos alunos, bem como com a instrução planejada;
  • Manter comunicação frequente com Coordenadores de Atendimento, Coordenadores de Segmento e professores de alunos de seu segmento, compartilhando informações sobre o desempenho dos alunos e buscando apoio necessário;
  • Se comunicar, sempre que necessário, com a família e com outros profissionais que trabalham com os alunos sob sua responsabilidade fora da escola, compartilhando informações necessárias para o bom atendimento dos alunos;
  • Demonstrar profissionalismo através de manutenção de confidencialidade de informações, compromisso com o crescimento dos mediadores, compromisso com horários e manutenção de ambiente justo e ético.

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. title: Completion Engineer (Lower Completion Specialist)
description:
Focusing on lower completions, this position will plan, design, and execute lower completion and gravel pack operations, provide offshore technical supervision, coordinate with wells, subsurface, and operations teams, and ensure proper well closeout and reporting.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare and present well design concepts based on information provided by Subsurface team
  • Assist with the preparation of cost estimates used to generate yearly Budgets and well/project specific AFE's
  • Forecast and accountable for the timely ordering of well/project specific Long Lead requirements
  • Contribute towards logistical coordination & quality assurance of services, materials, equipment and personnel
  • Integrate with fellow drilling, completion/testing, subsea and/or subsurface team members as required
  • Perform special studies/duties if/as required including conducting service quality meetings
  • Ensure Vendor service deficiencies are correctly and timely captured via the Company non-conformance reporting (NCR) process so as to ensure timely action/close out
  • Support NCR and root cause failure analysis as required
  • Contributor to the development, management and updating of the Drilling Management System (DMS)
  • Ensure the DMS is followed during well planning, design, engineering, and execution and closeout activities
  • Ensure compliance with Company and Drilling & Completion policies, standards and approved procedures
  • Ensure compliance of Vendor supplied materials, equipment and services which includes review of design, pre-assembly verification, pre-installation testing and equipment documentation
  • Support the preparation of HSE documents if/where required
  • Contribute and participate in the hazard identification process
  • Contribute and participate in well/project specific risk assessments and pre-job planning meetings
  • Assist with the evaluation of rig and 3rd party services for hazards, well integrity and assurance
  • Support Drilling Management if requested in ER roles and incident investigations

Well/Project Specific Duties

  • Design Reservoir Lower Completion for producer and injector wells across different assets within the company
  • Perform Torque & Drag analysis for deploying lower completions in long horizontal wells. Specify landing string and evaluate the requirement for swiveling devices
  • Provide engineering support as part of the wells team which includes lower completion sizing and design, GP pumping schedule, costing and assisting with operation execution, as well as the services associated with these activities
  • Establish well/project life cycle functional and operational requirements, including material & equipment selection
  • Identify special Engineering Studies to be performed
  • Prepare well/project specific technical notes if/when required
  • Prepare detailed scopes of work for tender documents, perform vendor capability assessments, evaluate tenders methodically and capable of presenting a succinct recommendation
  • Raise Requisitions & Purchase Orders
  • Ensure compliance of Vendor supplied goods, materials, equipment and services which includes but is not limited to review of design, manufacturing processes, quality plans, post-manufacturing testing/verification, site receipt acceptance, pre-assembly verification, pre-installation testing and equipment documentation
  • Review all applicable operating, installing & testing procedures, including interface documents
  • Contribute and participate in DWOP/CWOP as part of well/project commencement
  • Assist with preparation of Management of Change (MOC) documents and conducting a risk assessment for those changes with relevant parties
  • Review field tickets and/or well invoices
  • Review the engineering focussed After Action Review (AAR) report and apply lessons learnt
  • Responsible for compilation of End of well Reports (EOWRs)

Requirements

Education

  • Degree qualification in Engineering
  • Well Control certification (IWCF) - Subsea/Surface Supervisor is considered an advantage

Experience

  • Experience in Lower Completion and GP Pumping engineering
  • Experience with lower completion and sand control designs and execution
  • Experience with Alternate Path GP pumping technology is considered an advantage
  • Knowledge of appropriate and relevant well engineering tools (e.g. Landmark Suite (or similar) - Wellplan, Stresscheck, Compass, etc), and software packages
  • Knowledge of GP pumping software PackPro or similar

Job Details

  • Seniority level: Mid-Senior level
  • Employment type: Full-time
  • Job function: Project Management
  • Industries: IT Services and IT Consulting

title: Partnership Sales Lead
description:
Partnership Sales Manager.

IWG – Partnership Sales Lead

Are you ready to lead the charge and be at the forefront of our ambitious global expansion? Is hunting, pitching and prospecting second nature to you? Can you confidently agree high-value commercial deals with building owners? Is business development in your blood? And are you relentless in your pursuit of delivering results, with the determination and resilience to change the world of work?

If yes, we need to talk.

What we can do for you

You’re reading the right ad if you’re looking for:

  • The most exciting growth opportunity in the world, where you’ll be challenged every day
  • Excellent training, development and promotion opportunities
  • A fantastic incentive scheme which can see you earn great commission and prizes.

We know we can only succeed if we give all our people every opportunity to shine. It’s why so many of our most senior leaders started their careers in our centres. And it’s what made IWG the dominant global leader in the flexible-workspace industry.

About IWG

IWG is the world’s leading flexible workspace provider – with the world’s most ambitious growth programme to open 30,000+ new centres over the next decade to complement our international network of 4,000+ tech-enabled, sustainable and inspiring flexible work centres. Across our multiple brands, including Regus, Spaces, HQ and Signature, we’re provide world-beating workplace solutions to over 80% of Fortune 500 companies, including Netflix, EY, Amazon and Uber, as well as to local small start-ups, entrepreneurs and emerging businesses.

About you

You’ll need to be passionate about working in a high-growth sector and ready to play a leading role in disrupting the commercial real-estate industry. You’ll excel at growing your network rapidly and taking our proposition to them. And you’ll thrive on initiating and closing multiple high-value deals at pace driven by your tenacity and expertise.

Whether pursuing your own leads or following up on centrally-driven enquiries, you’ll highlight what makes an IWG partnership so special. By ensuring prospective partners fully understand the value of our proposition, you’ll be doing much more than simply meeting sales targets. And thanks to your outstanding communications skills – primarily in your local language but also with a good level of English – you’ll be able to present a truly compelling narrative to large and small audiences alike.

Most importantly though, you’ll have the right, can-do mindset: passion, curiosity, pride, drive and ownership. We’ll look after the rest.

What you’ll be doing

Join our team of over 200 Partnerships Sales Leaders and you’ll get to harness your entrepreneurial mindset, strong business and financial acumen, and commitment to achieving outstanding business development results as we add to the over 1,000 deals in 50+ countries closed in the past year alone.

From one day to the next, you’ll get the chance to:

  • Agree high-value deals to deliver inspiring new partner locations, leveraging your expertise to expand the IWG network in every town and city
  • Hunt out exciting opportunities in commercial buildings of all types across your region, pitch for new partnership opportunities, convince partners to invest anywhere from £250k to £1m+ to develop a new IWG branded centre and close out deals quickly & effectively
  • Showcase the value of the IWG partnership proposition to your network of B2B connections
  • Source ambitious partners who match our growth goals and can help drive our rapid growth through building conversions, new development locations or competitor conversions
  • Employ a dynamic and versatile approach to business development, tailoring it to our partners’ varying commercial needs and requirements
  • Actively manage your pipeline of opportunities to drive each opportunity from initial contact, through detailed commercial negotiations, all the way to a signed commercial agreement.

Carbon Neutral Workplaces

IWG’s purpose is to help everyone have a great day at work, while protecting people and the planet. We are proud to supply all our customers with carbon-neutral workplaces, and have a strong climate action plan in place to help us achieve our objective of Net Zero emissions by 2040.

Leading Employer Award

IWG is proud to be the recipient of a Leading Employer Award in 2022, 2023 and 2024. Awarded exclusively to the top 1% of employers, the accolade is testament to our diverse global workforce and the role everyone plays in bringing our purpose, culture and values to life, every single day.

A XP Inc. é uma das maiores instituições financeiras independente do Brasil, dona das marcas XP, Rico, Clear, XP Educação, InfoMoney, entre outras. Com mais de 4,6 milhões de clientes ativos e um valor superior a R$ 1,1 trilhão de ativos sob custódia, há 24 anos vem transformando o mercado financeiro para melhorar a vida das pessoas.

Com uma cultura marcante guiada por quatro valores - Sonho Grande, Espírito Empreendedor, Foco no Cliente e Mente Aberta - a XP Inc. está sempre em busca dos melhores talentos que tem ambição de fazer o impossível.

Tem perfil comercial, busca transição de carreira e quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance?

Conheça o XP Future - Rio de Janeiro , uma iniciativa disruptiva para profissionais com alto skill comercial e que desejam se tornar assessores de investimentos.

Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro.

Na XP Inc. você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira para que você se torne um profissional comercial de sucesso na corretora, e tire a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor referência no mercado!

Se você já possui experiência comercial em outros segmentos e deseja fazer uma transição de carreira para o mercado financeiro, conheça os pré-requisitos para iniciar no XP Future logo abaixo!

O Que Procuramos

  • Ter a nossa cultura;

  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente no Rio de Janeiro;

Diferenciais:

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;

  6. Entrevista focada em cultura : Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

  7. Oferta : Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função, podendo ser totalmente presencial para frentes de negócio e mais flexível para outras equipes. Overview

O Instrutor de Well Control é responsável por ministrar treinamentos de Controle de Poço de acordo com os padrões do IADC Well Sharp (níveis Introdutório, Driller e Supervisor – Superfície e Subsea). Este profissional deve assegurar que os participantes adquiram conhecimentos teóricos e práticos para operar com segurança em cenários de perfuração e controle de poços.

The Well Control Instructor is responsible for delivering Well Control training in accordance with IADC WellSharp standards (Introductory, Driller, and Supervisor levels – Surface and Subsea). This professional must ensure that participants acquire the theoretical knowledge and practical skills required to operate safely in drilling and well control scenarios.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Ministrar aulas teóricas e práticas de Controle de Poço conforme o currículo oficial do IADC WellSharp.

  • Conduzir treinamentos práticos em simuladores, replicando cenários reais de controle de poço (kicks, shut-in, kill methods, etc.).

  • Aplicar avaliações e exames, garantindo conformidade com os requisitos de qualidade e integridade definidos pelo IADC.

  • Elaborar relatórios de desempenho, registro de frequência e resultados dos alunos no sistema da IADC e nos controles internos.

  • Assegurar a atualização contínua dos materiais didáticos, simuladores e recursos de treinamento, em alinhamento com a versão vigente do programa.

  • Participar de auditorias internas e externas, contribuindo para a manutenção da acreditação do centro de treinamento.

  • Colaborar com a equipe de instrutores e suporte técnico no desenvolvimento e aprimoramento dos cursos.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Certificação: Instrutor aprovado pelo IADC WellSharp para ministrar cursos de Controle de Poço

  • Conhecimento Técnico: - Métodos de controle de poço (Driller’s Method, Wait & Weight, Volumetric, Bullheading) - Pressões de formação, influxo, hidráulica de poço, operações de cimentação e revestimento - Normas e boas práticas internacionais (IADC, IWCF, API, ANP).

  • Idiomas: Inglês avançado (mandatório).

We are looking for

  • Certification: IADC WellSharp-approved Instructor authorized to deliver Well Control courses.

  • Technical Knowledge: - Well control methods (Driller’s Method, Wait & Weight, Volumetric, Bullheading) -Formation pressures, influx behavior, well hydraulics, casing, and cementing operations -International standards and best practices (IADC, IWCF, API, ANP).

  • Languages: Advanced English (mandatory).

Se você valoriza desafios, aprendizado e um ambiente leve, vem #SerFeliz na Every! Vaga presencial para o Rio de Janeiro.

  • Servir como o principal ponto de contato para negociações complexas de contratos e resolução de conflitos, assegurando um entendimento claro das necessidades dos clientes;

  • Elaborar relatórios detalhados para a alta administração, apresentando insights e recomendações de melhorias contínuas e ações corretivas;

  • Realizar previsões de vendas e análises financeiras que sustentem decisões estratégicas e a alocação de recursos;
  • Colaborar com as equipes de marketing, operações e atendimento ao cliente para alinhar esforços e aprimorar a jornada do cliente, promovendo uma experiência positiva;
  • Participar ativamente de reuniões interdepartamentais para garantir que as metas comerciais estejam em consonância com os objetivos gerais da empresa;
  • Identificar, prospectar e cultivar novos clientes e oportunidades de negócios no setor de segurança da informação, expandindo a base de clientes da empresa;
  • Conduzir pesquisas de mercado e análise de necessidades dos clientes para descobrir novas oportunidades de vendas e parcerias;
  • Desenvolver, implementar e otimizar processos de vendas e melhores práticas que garantam a eficiência operacional e a satisfação do cliente;
  • Utilizar e gerenciar ferramentas de CRM para monitorar melhorias contínuas nas práticas de vendas e no relacionamento com os clientes;
  • Proporcionar treinamentos regulares à equipe de vendas sobre as soluções de segurança da informação, técnicas de vendas e estratégias de atendimento ao cliente;
  • Identificar as necessidades de desenvolvimento da equipe e promover ações de capacitação para impulsionar o desempenho;
  • Representar a empresa em conferências, feiras e eventos de segurança da informação, promovendo os produtos e serviços da empresa e estabelecendo conexões valiosas com potenciais clientes e parceiros.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Nível superior completo ou em andamento;
  • Desejável: Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão Comercial, Vendas ou Segurança da Informação é um diferencial;
  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em vendas técnicas ou comerciais, com pelo menos 2 anos em uma posição de liderança em empresas de tecnologia ou cibersegurança.

title: Senior Product Manager (Bangkok-based)
description:
Senior Product Manager (Bangkok-based) – Agoda

Join to apply for the Senior Product Manager (Bangkok-based) role at Agoda .

About Agoda

Agoda is an online travel booking platform for accommodations, flights, and more. We build and deploy cutting-edge technology that connects travelers with a global network of 4.7M hotels and holiday properties worldwide, plus flights, activities, and more. Based in Asia and part of Booking Holdings, our 7,100+ employees representing 95+ nationalities in 27 markets foster a work environment rich in diversity, creativity, and collaboration. We innovate through a culture of experimentation and ownership, enhancing the ability for our customers to experience the world.

Our Purpose - Bridging the World Through Travel

We believe travel allows people to enjoy, learn and experience more of the amazing world we live in. It brings individuals and cultures closer together, fostering empathy, understanding and happiness. We are a skillful, driven and diverse team from across the globe, united by a passion to make an impact. Harnessing our innovative technologies and strong partnerships, we aim to make travel easy and rewarding for everyone.

Your opportunity

This role is BANGKOK-BASED, RELOCATION PROVIDED. Our Senior Product Managers are analytical and data-driven individuals, responsible for building products end-to-end, focusing on analyzing and experimenting until our solutions are perfectly tailored to our travelers. You will drive product strategy and partner closely with senior leadership cross-functionally to define, build, and deliver the best travel solutions. You will get dedicated engineering resources that you, and only you, define and allocate. We expect you to have a hands-on mentality and spend considerable time with your SCRUM teams, have enthusiasm to develop engineered processes and technologies and apply innovative solutions to make organizational improvements. Product Managers can modify every system we have in our company to suit their needs.

By applying to this role, you'll be considered for a role either in User Experience, Marketing, Finance or Supply product vertical. The goal is to match you with the team that best aligns with your interests, competencies, and where you will have the most impact. We’re looking for Senior Product Managers for every part of our business. Our entire Product team sits in Bangkok. This is an Individual Contributor position.

You will get to:

  • Analyze the online travel ecosystem, markets, competitive landscape and user requirements
  • Conceptualize, launch and optimize products and features, experiment, test their performance and iterate quickly
  • Work collaboratively with Engineering, Marketing, Legal and UX teams on cutting-edge technologies
  • Develop innovative solutions to some of the world’s difficult problems by collaborating as needed across regions, product areas, and functions

What you'll need to succeed:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field (e.g., Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Mathematics, or similar quantitative discipline)
  • Proven ability to leverage analytics and quantitative methods to inform and influence decision-making
  • Strong data skills
  • Excellent communication skills (verbal and written in English) with proven ability to convey complex messages clearly to different stakeholders
  • Experience developing and launching products
  • Experience leading global product vision, go-to-market strategy and design discussions
  • Entrepreneurial and analytical skills; effective at breaking down complex problems and driving and managing change
  • Hands-on mentality

Nice to have:

  • MBA or Master’s degree in Math, Economics, Computer Science or Statistics
  • Data tools - SQL, Python, R, or equivalent

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Agoda, we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds and orientations. We prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and innovation. Employment at Agoda is based solely on a person’s merit and qualifications. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity regardless of sex, age, race, color, national origin, religion, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, citizenship, veteran or military status, and other legally protected characteristics.

We will keep your application on file so that we can consider you for future vacancies and you can always ask to have your details removed from the file. For more details please read our privacy policy.

Disclaimer

We do not accept any terms or conditions, nor do we recognize any agency’s representation of a candidate, from unsolicited third-party or agency submissions. If we receive unsolicited or speculative CVs, we reserve the right to contact and hire the candidate directly without any obligation to pay a recruitment fee.

Employment type

Job function

title: Surveyor I
description:
The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements:

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

title: Lead ML Engineer, Recommendation Systems
description:
Overview

As The Discovery and Conversion Company, our mission is to connect consumers with the world’s leading brands through data-driven content and technology.

Headquartered in South Florida with a remote-first team spanning over 15 countries, we’ve built a high-growth, high-performance culture where speed, ownership, and measurable impact drive success.

WHY JOIN US?

At Launch Potato, you’ll accelerate your career by owning outcomes, moving fast, and driving impact with a global team of high-performers.

We convert audience attention into action through data, machine learning, and continuous optimization.

We’re hiring a Machine Learning Engineer (Recommendation Systems) to build the personalization engine behind our portfolio of brands. You’ll design, deploy, and scale ML systems that power real-time recommendations across millions of user journeys. This role gives you the chance to work on systems serving 100M+ predictions daily, directly impacting engagement, retention, and revenue at scale.

MUST HAVE

You’ve shipped large-scale ML systems into production that power personalization at scale. You’re fluent in ranking algorithms and know how to turn data into engagement and conversions. Specifically:

  • 7+ years building and scaling production ML systems with measurable business impact
  • Strong background in ranking algorithms (collaborative filtering, learning-to-rank, deep learning)
  • Proficiency with Python and ML frameworks (TensorFlow or PyTorch)
  • Skilled with SQL and modern data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) plus data lakes
  • Familiarity with distributed computing (Spark, Ray) and LLM/AI Agent frameworks
  • Track record of improving business KPIs via ML-powered personalization
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms and experiment logging best practices

YOUR ROLE

Your mission: Drive business growth by building and optimizing the recommendation systems that personalize experience for millions of users daily. You’ll own the modeling, feature engineering, data pipelines, and experimentation that make personalization smarter, faster, and more impactful.

OUTCOMES

  • Build and deploy ML models serving 100M+ predictions per day to personalize user experiences at scale
  • Enhance data processing pipelines (Spark, Beam, Dask) with efficiency and reliability improvements
  • Design ranking algorithms that balance relevance, diversity, and revenue
  • Deliver real-time personalization with latency <50ms across key product surfaces
  • Run statistically rigorous A/B tests to measure true business impact
  • Optimize for latency, throughput, and cost efficiency in production
  • Partner with product, engineering, and analytics to launch high-impact personalization features
  • Implement monitoring systems and maintain clear ownership for model reliability

COMPETENCIES

  • Technical Mastery: You know ML architecture, deployment, and tradeoffs inside out
  • Experimentation Infrastructure: You set up systems for rapid testing and retraining (MLflow, W&B)
  • Impact-Driven: You design models that move revenue, retention, or engagement
  • Collaborative: You thrive working with engineers, PMs, and analysts to scope features
  • Analytical Thinking: You break down data trends and design rigorous test methodologies
  • Ownership Mentality: You own your models post-deployment and continuously improve them
  • Execution-Oriented: You deliver production-grade systems quickly without sacrificing rigor
  • Curious & Innovative: You stay on top of ML advances and apply them to personalization

Want to accelerate your career? Apply now!

title: Country Finance Manager - Brazil & Argentina
description:
Country Finance Manager - Brazil & Argentina

Join to apply for the Country Finance Manager - Brazil & Argentina role at Accelleron

Accelleron is accelerating sustainability in the marine and energy industries as a global technology leader in turbocharging, fuel injection, and digital solutions for heavy-duty applications. Building on a heritage of over 100 years as a trusted industry partner, the company serves customers in more than 100 locations in over 50 countries. Accelleron’s 3,000 employees are continuously innovating to deliver best-in-class products, services, and solutions that are mission-critical for the energy transition. You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting-edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions. At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength.

Job Description

  • As the key financial leader for Area Brazil and Argentina, you will act as copilot of the Country Managing Director (CMD) and be responsible for all local finance and commercial management matters.
  • Partnering closely with the CMD, you will play a critical role in steering the direction and success of the organization by providing timely and accurate financial insights and demonstrating strong business acumen.
  • You will lead and oversee all aspects of controlling, accounting, reporting, internal control, commercial management, fiduciary responsibilities, treasury, and tax matters to sustainably optimize business performance and financial position.
  • Representing the company externally, you will ensure full compliance with all legal requirements and internal policies.
  • The Country Finance Manager (CFM) reports to the Global Division Controller & Commercial Manager Service and the Country Managing Director.

Your Responsibilities

  • Strategic Leadership: Contribute to the local implementation of the Accelleron business strategy, providing strategic financial leadership and direction.
  • Business Planning: Develop and translate strategy into comprehensive business plans (budget/forecast), set measurable targets, and coordinate/oversee the corresponding processes. Assess financial implications of strategic decisions, create, and evaluate business scenarios, and initiate corrective actions when necessary.
  • Performance Management and decision support: Monitor financial performance across multiple dimensions, delivering insights to support both operational and strategic decision-making. Drive cost structure optimization, productivity improvements, and capital efficiency to maximize value creation.
  • Commercial and Risk Management: Identify and communicate commercial and financial risks and opportunities arising from business propositions, such as contracts. Conduct risk and contract reviews in line with global policies and standards to minimize risks and exposure. Monitor overdue accounts to mitigate default risk and safeguard company assets.
  • Financial Reporting: Establish and oversee processes and tools to ensure transparent and reliable financial data, reported in compliance with Group standards (US-GAAP) and financial closing schedules.
  • Accounting and Statutory Reporting: Ensure accurate financial bookkeeping (via our external Accounting Service Provider) in accordance with local accounting principles. Ensure timely preparation of accurate statutory financial statements.
  • Tax Compliance: Responsible for the preparation and filing of accurate tax returns (including timely payment) for corporate income taxes, transfer pricing and indirect taxes, in collaboration with your tax service provider. Ensure adherence to Accelleron tax policies as well as local and international tax regulations to ensure full tax compliance. Monitor changes in local tax legislation and assess their impact with local and global experts.
  • Governance, Compliance, and Audits: Establish and maintain local governance in line with corporate standards, regulations, policies, and legal requirements. Ensure effective execution of internal controls for financial and specified non-financial operations. Coordinate external audits and support internal audits, acting as a liaison with the global legal and integrity function. Act as Secretary to the Board of Directors. Ensure regulatory filings, reporting, and other general affairs tasks.
  • Treasury Management: Secure, plan and manage the company’s liquidity, including investment and debt management. Responsible for the local bank relationships, including the management of bank accounts, bank guarantees and other local banking services. Identify and manage foreign exchange risks, implementing hedging strategies in accordance with Group policies. Oversee the company's local insurance policies and credit risk management in alignment with Group guidelines.

Your Background

  • University degree in Finance/Controlling or Chartered Financial Accountant (e.g., ACCA, ACA, ICAEW, ICAS, CPA, CIMA) or extensive practical work experience with demonstrated achievements.
  • Up-to-date knowledge of local statutory accounting principles (BR GAAP, ARG GAAP) and US-GAAP/IFRS, combined with practical application experience.
  • Demonstrated experience in tax compliance, specifically in preparing and filing corporate income tax returns, managing transfer pricing, and handling indirect taxes.
  • Strong financial background with a structured and results-oriented approach and exceptional analytical skills.
  • High IT proficiency with experience in SAP (S4Hana is a strong advantage) and Microsoft Office products.
  • Proven team player with strong problem-solving skills, an open-minded approach to challenges, and the persistence to deliver on time.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously, ideally with corresponding work experience from within a matrix organization.
  • 7+ years of experience in a controlling/accounting role within an international environment, preferably with an industrial background.
  • Demonstrated leadership skills with a commitment to coaching and developing team members to reach their professional goals.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese is a must, while proficiency in Spanish is a strong advantage

Your Benefits

  • Competitive compensation package
  • International development opportunities
  • Modern office environment with flexible working arrangements
  • Lunch allowances
  • Insurance policy
  • Employee Assistance program

description:
About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Technical Sales Specialist, Geophysicist to join our team at Seequent. The successful candidate will provide exceptional support to our customers, ensuring they maximize the value of our solutions.

The role involves providing technical support, training, and project assistance to customers, as well as acting as a regional technical advocate and supporting the local sales team with product demonstrations and implementation plans.

Responsibilities

  • Provide technical support for Seequent solutions and partner products
  • Assist customers during trial and post-purchase phases to maximize the value of our solutions
  • Conduct user interactions through face-to-face conversations, telephone, and email to ensure successful resolution of issues
  • Proactively contact users to complete health checks and identify additional support, training, or sales opportunities
  • Act as the regional technical advocate for Seequent’s Geophysics portfolio across all market sectors
  • Support the local sales team with product demonstrations, understanding customer needs, and developing implementation plans
  • Identify new influencers and decision-makers within customer organizations
  • Provide feedback to software development teams to enhance product functionality
  • Deliver training to new customers and integrate Seequent solutions into their workflows
  • Mentor the technical customer solutions team to build confidence in training situations
  • Collaborate with the local marketing specialist to promote geophysics solutions in regional marketing activities
  • Monitor customer satisfaction levels and work to improve outcomes
  • Assist and support all product upgrades, new releases, and new products

Requirements

  • Degree in Geophysics
  • Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in geophysics and related disciplines
  • Experience and/or operational skills in geoscience software solutions, ideally including Seequent’s software (Oasis Montaj, Res2Dinv/Res3Dinv, Workbench or SPIA)
  • Confident oral and written communication skills in English and Fluent Portuguese or Spanish
  • Understanding of how cultural differences influence business relations
  • Excellent interpersonal skills to develop and build sustainable working relationships
  • Proven team player with conflict management skills
  • Ability to work well independently, manage workload effectively, and adapt to a fast-paced, constantly changing environment

Working Conditions

The Technical Sales Specialist position at Seequent follows a office-based work schedule, requiring the employee to work in the office from Tuesday to Thursday during standard office hours. The remaining days of the week can be worked remotely, providing flexibility while ensuring consistent in-person collaboration and support during the core mid-weekdays

Our Commitment to Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion

At Seequent, we champion the uniqueness of each individual. Our commitment to inclusiveness, equity, and accessibility is fundamental to who we are. If you require accommodation during our recruitment process, please let our Talent Acquisition team know. We are here to ensure a fair opportunity for all.

Benefits of being a Seequenteer

We aspire to be pioneers of positive change in the way organisations work with the underground. We work collaboratively, stay curious, make change happen and have a global impact. We bring our authentic selves to work and are enthusiastic about what we do. Plus, you can expect great benefits; these benefits are unique to each location Seequent resides in.

title: Interpretation Geophysicist
description:
Join to apply for the Interpretation Geophysicist role at Viridien .

Viridien ( is an advanced technology, digital and Earth data company that pushes the boundaries of science for a more prosperous and sustainable future. With our ingenuity, drive and deep curiosity we discover new insights, innovations, and solutions that efficiently and responsibly resolve complex natural resource, digital, energy transition and infrastructure challenges.

Job Summary

We are looking for passionate geoscientists to join our Interpretation Team at Viridien. In this role, you will contribute directly to Velocity Model Building (VMB) by performing seismic interpretation and providing essential geological support to Processing and VMB teams. From picking horizons to building velocity scenarios, you will work at the intersection of geology, geophysics, and advanced imaging tools, helping to transform complex seismic data into meaningful insights. Your work will play a critical role in delivering high-quality results to our clients and shaping decisions across energy and earth-data projects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform seismic interpretation for VMB, including horizon picking (unconformities, salt horizons, pre-salt).
  • Create local velocity scenarios.
  • Apply imaging tools, workflows, and data QC (attributes, velocities, maps).
  • Integrate geological and geophysical data for deeper insights.
  • Engage directly with clients to present results and understand their perspectives.

About The Team

You will join a diverse group of interpreters, geologists, and geophysicists who collaborate closely with Processing and VMB teams. Together, we tackle complex challenges, share knowledge, and drive innovation in seismic imaging. At Viridien, collaboration is key — you will be encouraged to bring your ideas forward and grow in a supportive environment.

Qualifications

  • Master’s or PhD in Geophysics, Geology, or related field; or equivalent professional experience in the Oil & Gas industry.
  • Solid background in seismic interpretation, exploration geology, stratigraphy, or basin analysis.
  • Strong geophysical knowledge (seismic attributes, AVO, reservoir characterization, quantitative interpretation, well data QC/processing).
  • Ability to integrate data across scales (well, seismic, potential data).
  • Good understanding of seismic imaging and prospect assessment.
  • Experience with Pre-Salt or Brazilian Equatorial Margin is a plus.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
  • Effective communication and presentation skills in English.
  • Python programming is a plus.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary with performance-based bonus.
  • Relocation package (when applicable).
  • Comprehensive health and dental insurance.
  • Private Pension Plan
  • Meal Voucher
  • Free breakfast and snacks at the office.
  • Shiatsu Therapy at the Office
  • TotalPass Fitness Program
  • Hybrid Work Model (up to 2 remote days per week)
  • Birthday Day Off
  • Christmas Gift Card
  • Educational Assistance and Language Learning Programs
  • Continuous training via the Learning Hub, with both technical and behavioral courses.

Our Hiring Process

At Viridien, we are committed to delivering a respectful, inclusive, and transparent recruitment experience. We may not be able to provide individual feedback to every applicant due to high application volumes. Candidates whose qualifications closely match the role criteria will be contacted for an interview, and we aim to share personalized feedback with those who progress to the first round and beyond. If you require any reasonable adjustments to participate in the application or interview stages, please contact your recruiter directly. We value diversity and are committed to equal employment opportunities for all professionals.

title: Consultor de vendas
description:
Overview

Tudo o que fazemos é por acreditar que existe um grande potencial não explorado em cada ser humano. Nosso propósito é transformar a vida das pessoas ao descobrir sua melhor versão. Somos o melhor curso de comunicação e oratória do Brasil; ajudamos pessoas e empresas a melhorarem suas performances e resultados através de uma metodologia única e inovadora que combina técnicas de oratória, fonoaudiologia, neurociência, psicologia positiva e técnicas teatrais.

Nossa cultura: No nosso dia a dia, nos propomos a fazer diferente na vida dos nossos clientes e colaboradores de forma única e eficiente, porque acreditamos que cada ser humano é único e tem grande potencial a ser descoberto e desenvolvido. Isso se tangibiliza em atitudes práticas e em nossos valores:

  • Excelência: Ter compromisso por fazer o melhor, sempre. Valorizar o cuidado com os detalhes e a busca constante pela alta qualidade em tudo o que faz.
  • Coragem: Encarar as mudanças e desafios de frente, com confiança e determinação, acreditando que cada adversidade é uma oportunidade para o crescimento e transformação.
  • Inovação: Inovar com paixão e estar sempre em busca de novas ideias e soluções que tragam resultados impactantes, transformando vidas.
  • Sabedoria: Aprender e crescer continuamente. Investir em conhecimento e desenvolvimento e garantir o sucesso em tudo o que se propõe a fazer.
  • Bom humor: Cultivar um ambiente leve e descontraído. Saber encarar os desafios com positividade e leveza.
  • Acolhimento: Priorizar as pessoas, cuidar das relações e contribuir para um ambiente de trabalho saudável.

Seus Principais Objetivos São:

  • Conectar com leads quentes e frios, com foco em gerar novas oportunidades de negócios;
  • Qualificar prospects e entender suas necessidades;
  • Aprimoramento e captação de informações comerciais;
  • Mapear oportunidades de venda e realizar a oferta de nossos produtos/serviços;
  • Agendar reunião para fechamento da venda entre o potencial cliente e nossos executivos de venda;
  • Qualificar e desenvolver os leads gerados por nossas estratégias de marketing;
  • Atualizar as informações no CRM e softwares de sales engagement com pontos relevantes sobre as oportunidades identificadas;
  • Trabalhar o social selling e aprofundar relacionamento com os leads por meio de canais sociais.

Procuramos por Pessoas (atentem-se às soft skills abaixo):

  • Pessoas com raciocínio lógico;
  • Bom relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Ótima dicção;
  • Adaptabilidade;
  • Visão sistêmica;
  • Solucionadoras de problemas;
  • Criativas e empreendedoras;
  • Organizadas e disciplinadas para contribuir com a performance do time;
  • Que AMEM trabalhar em equipe (aqui não aceitamos egoísmo, nem competições não saudáveis);
  • Resilientes e Pacientes (confortáveis no desconforto e lidando com o desconhecido);
  • Proativas e Independentes (com vontade de aprender e resolver problemas de forma autônoma);
  • Que tenham espírito empreendedor.

Requisitos:

  • Pacote Office básico;
  • Facilidade de comunicação e escrita;
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Facilidade em aprender coisas novas.

Diferenciais:

  • Ensino Superior em andamento;
  • Facilidade com ferramentas de tecnologia;
  • Noções básicas de inglês; Experiência como SDR;
  • Conhecimento prévio na metodologia SPIN Selling;
  • Conhecimento de CRM.

Em troca, você terá:

  • SEM TETO DE GANHOS

At Dover Fueling Solutions (DFS), we are taking fueling and convenience retail to the next level. We are passionate about cultivating excellence in everything we do, but what really fuels us is our people. They’re the heart of our company. As an employee, our promise to you is that you’ll work on new and innovative products and solutions, be mentored by managers and teammates who are collaborative, caring, and act with integrity, and have the opportunity to grow in ways that are meaningful to you. Unique and interesting projects – both locally and globally – will challenge you and allow you to pursue different and rewarding career paths.
We are #EnergizedByGrowth.
DFS is part of a legacy of leadership that spans back generations, made up of some of the most trusted, leading-edge brands in the industry. As part of Dover Corporation and with our talented, innovative, outstanding people, we are doing great things and redefining what is possible in fueling and convenience retail. Providing advanced fuel-dispensing equipment, including clean energy solutions, systems and payment, automatic tank gauging and wet stock-management solutions, DFS comprises the product brands of Wayne Fueling Systems, OPW Fuel Management Systems, ClearView, Tokheim, ProGauge, Fairbanks, LIQAL, AvaLAN, and Bulloch Technologies. Headquartered in Austin, TX, DFS has a significant technology development and manufacturing presence worldwide, including facilities in Brazil, China, India, Italy, Poland, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom and the United States.
Primary Responsibilities

  • Responsible for checking the accuracy of import/export recordkeeping.
  • Manage, request, and compile necessary import documentation to ensure entry accuracy.
  • Partner with different teams like sales and customer services teams on due diligence process, including but not limited to Know your customer, screening, and vetting.
  • Support local entity’s participation on FTA (Free trade agreement) under the guidance from Corp. compliance and partner with functional teams on the necessary supporting calculation and collection.
  • Partner with Engineering to ensure accurate Harmonized Tariff classifications, maintain internal classification databases and ensure accuracy of customs entries.
  • Assist in maintaining part databases with global trade compliance data including product classifications, HTS Codes, and country of origin classifications.
  • Audit Import entry data and manage any Post Entry Amendment requirements with the broker.
  • Coordinate audits to ensure import/export policies are followed and identify necessary corrective action plans to continuous improvement.
  • Monitoring program including broker review, post entry etc.
  • Manage the proper reporting of assists as related to Dover trade compliance policy.
  • Provide training with the support from corporate compliance team to local entities on different trade compliance topic.
  • General compliance support, including VC (screening tool), TPG (3rd party vetting platform), code of conduct, conflict of interest, training etc.
  • Other duties pertaining to corporate compliance as assigned.
Qualifications/Experience Requirements
  • Additional experience in supply chain, traffic, logistics, business is highly desired.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, with a positive, team-oriented approach.
  • Ability to assess risk and recommend actions and strategies to mitigate regulatory risks.
  • Self-starter with the ability to work independently on multiple tasks to meet deadlines, prioritize, and maintain flexibility in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Experience in tariff classification and country of origin determination. Engineering background in HTS Classification is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of documentation requirements and Brazil Customs regulations.
  • Data analysis and Excel skills proficiency.
  • Brazil Customs Brokerage License not required, but highly desirable.
  • Impeccable ethics and trustworthiness.
Work Arrangement : Hybrid

Principais Responsabilidades



  • Coordenar e executar treinamentos para as equipes de vendas e operação em lojas franqueadas e próprias.

  • Realizar gestão do time de Instrutores de Treinamento de cada região;

Overview

Primary Care Physician - BC Family Medicine at Community Health Centers of the Central Coast, Inc. (CHC). Reports To: Chief Medical Officer. FLSA Status: Exempt. Wage Range: $9,230.77 - $11,220.06 bi-weekly.

Summary: Under the direction of the Chief Medical Officer, but with independent responsibility for professional results, the Physician provides primary healthcare services for CHC and performs related work as required. CHC aims to provide the highest quality of total care to the patient population; employees are expected to be professional, punctual, maintain regular attendance, cooperative, organized, and enthusiastic.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

  • Secure and evaluate a patient''s health history and record findings in a systematic, accurate, and succinct manner.
  • Perform physical assessments and discriminate between normal and abnormal findings.
  • Provide routine physical examinations, diagnostic services, and treatment of illnesses and emergencies.
  • Adhere to high ethical standards and assure quality of care for all patients.
  • Share on-call duties with other medical staff as indicated.
  • Elicit and record information about patient medical history; examine patients to determine general physical condition.
  • Order or execute tests, analyses, and diagnostic images; analyze reports and findings to diagnose conditions.
  • Administer or prescribe treatments and drugs; inoculate and vaccinate patients; advise on diet, hygiene, and disease prevention.
  • Report births, deaths, and outbreaks to governmental authorities; refer patients to specialists when needed.
  • Perform minor surgeries and conduct physicals for school admissions, job considerations, or insurance eligibility.
  • Assist the Chief Medical Officer in establishing medical policies and education programs; participate in care coordination and policy development as required.
  • Share supervisory responsibilities of the nurse practitioner with the Clinical Director as required; work within privileges and protocols established by the CMO.
  • Participate in committees as requested; adhere to safety and infection control policies; provide age-appropriate care across patient populations.
  • Maintain HIPAA-compliant, confidential communications; participate in patient population management with cultural sensitivity and appropriate local resources.
  • Coordinate with the Care Team to arrange appropriate services and support patient goals; contribute to quality improvement using evidence-based practices.

Supervisory Responsibilities

May supervise mid-level providers at the direction of the Chief Medical Officer.

Qualifications

  • Education: Medical Doctor (M.D.) or Doctor of Osteopathy (D.O.) from an accredited medical school.
  • Residency: Completion in Family Practice, Internal Medicine, OB/GYN, or Pediatrics; board certified or board eligible.
  • Licenses and Certifications: Current, unrestricted Physician and Surgeon license in California; current DEA license; ACLS for FP/IM; PALS for Pediatrics; BLS (all specialties).
  • Continuing education: Maintains current knowledge through CME and participation in relevant medical societies.
  • Language Skills: English required; Spanish bilingual desirable.

Education And/or Experience

As listed under Qualifications above.

Other Requirements

  • Ability to perform essential duties and accommodate reasonable accommodations as needed.
  • Physical demands and work environment as described below may apply: willing to work flexible hours, occasional travel to other clinic sites.

title: Manager/Specialist - Procurement Strategy (A&M Infra)
description:
Sobre a Alvarez & Marsal

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) é uma consultoria global com mais de 10.000 profissionais empreendedores, orientados para a ação e resultados, em mais de 40 países. Adotamos uma abordagem prática para resolver os problemas de nossos clientes e ajudá-los a atingir seu pleno potencial. Nossa cultura celebra pensadores independentes e realizadores que impactam positivamente nossos clientes e moldam nossa indústria. O ambiente colaborativo e o trabalho envolvente—guiados pelos valores centrais da A&M de Integridade, Qualidade, Objetividade, Diversão, Recompensa Pessoal e Diversidade Inclusiva—são as razões pelas quais nossos colaboradores adoram trabalhar na A&M.

A Equipe

A A&M Infra se dedica a todos os aspectos do ciclo de vida de projetos de capital intensivo, incluindo grandes empreendimentos nas áreas de logística, mineração, energia e O&G. Nossa atuação abrange desde a estruturação de projetos e processos de M&A relacionados a ativos de infraestrutura até todas as etapas de desenvolvimento e implementação, além da gestão dos ativos.

Como você irá contribuir

  • Liderar a execução de frentes de trabalho com propriedade, identificando iniciativas de melhoria, desempenhando papel ativo em todos os aspectos de envolvimento com o cliente;
  • Liderar reuniões e apresentações junto ao nível gerencial e executivo do cliente e da A&M, transmitindo segurança e domínio dos temas abordados;
  • Responder prontamente às demandas do projeto e antecipar ações críticas para o sucesso das iniciativas;
  • Atuação em diversos projetos e trabalho com vários colegas e clientes em uma variedade de setores e áreas funcionais;
  • Viabilizar articulações efetivas entre lideranças, conquistando alinhamentos e produzindo resultados que atendem aos interesses dos envolvidos;
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento da prática apoiando o desenvolvimento de produto e/ou indústria;
  • Desenvolver a conta que estiver atuando, identificando oportunidades e trabalhando em conjunto com a liderança para transformar em negócios;
  • Ser elo de conexão entre staff e liderança para disseminação de cultura e gestão de questões;
  • Coordenar e garantir adequações às questões administrativas (programação, planilha de vendas, collections, etc.).

Qualificações

  • Graduação completa;
  • Experiência comprovada em gerenciamento de projetos complexos em ambiente multicultural e corporativo nos setores de mineração e Óleo & Gás, seja em consultorias ou indústrias;
  • Pós-graduação em gestão de projetos e/ou administração ou finanças será um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento robusto dos produtos de I&CP;
  • Ao menos uma certificação em gestão de projetos de entidades preconizadas (ex: AACE, PMI, etc);
  • Habilidades de comunicação escrita e oral;
  • Disponibilidade para viajar;
  • Inglês avançado.

Sua jornada na A&M

Reconhecemos que nossos colaboradores são a força motriz por trás do nosso sucesso, e é por isso que priorizamos uma experiência que favorece o desenvolvimento profissional e pessoal único de cada pessoa. Nosso robusto processo de desenvolvimento de desempenho promove o aprendizado contínuo, recompensa suas contribuições e cultiva uma cultura de meritocracia. Com treinamentos de alta qualidade e oportunidades de aprendizado prático, você pode adquirir novas habilidades e avançar em sua carreira.

Priorizamos o seu bem-estar, oferecendo benefícios e recursos para apoiar sua jornada pessoal. Nossos colaboradores destacam constantemente as oportunidades de crescimento, nossa cultura empreendedora única e a diversão que vivenciamos juntos como os aspectos favoritos de trabalhar na A&M. As possibilidades são infinitas para profissionais de alto desempenho e paixão.

Diversidade & Inclusão

Diversidade Inclusiva significa que abraçamos a diversidade e promovemos a inclusão, incentivando todos a trazerem seu eu completo para o trabalho a cada dia. Isso permeia a maneira como recrutamos, desenvolvemos os colaboradores, conduzimos os negócios, apoiamos os clientes e fazemos parcerias com fornecedores. É a forma A&M de ser.

Empregador de Oportunidades Iguais

É prática da Alvarez & Marsal fornecer e promover oportunidades iguais em emprego, compensação e outras condições de trabalho, sem discriminação por raça, cor, credo, religião, origem nacional, ascendência, status de cidadania, sexo ou gênero, identidade de gênero ou expressão de gênero (incluindo status de pessoa transgênero), orientação sexual, estado civil, serviço militar e status de veterano, deficiência física ou mental, histórico médico familiar, informações genéticas ou qualquer outra condição médica protegida, afiliação política ou qualquer outra característica protegida por e em conformidade com as leis aplicáveis. Colaboradores e Candidatos podem encontrar as declarações de política da A&M e informações adicionais por região aqui.

Currículos Não Solicitados de Recrutadores de Terceiros

Informamos que, conforme a política da A&M, não aceitamos currículos não solicitados de recrutadores de terceiros, a menos que esses recrutadores sejam contratados para fornecer candidatos para uma vaga específica e em alinhamento com nossos valores de Diversidade Inclusiva. Qualquer agência de emprego, pessoa ou entidade que envie um currículo não solicitado o faz com o entendimento de que a A&M terá o direito de contratar esse candidato a seu critério, sem que haja qualquer taxa devida à agência de emprego, pessoa ou entidade que tenha enviado o currículo.

Inclusive Diversity

A&M’s entrepreneurial culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who can positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M’s core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are the main reasons our people love working at A&M. Inclusive Diversity means we embrace diversity, and we foster inclusiveness, encouraging everyone to bring their whole self to work each day. It runs through how we recruit, develop employees, conduct business, support clients, and partner with vendors. It is the A&M way.

Equal Opportunity Employer

It is Alvarez & Marsal’s practice to provide and promote equal opportunity in employment, compensation, and other terms and conditions of employment without discrimination because of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, sex or gender, gender identity or gender expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, family medical history, genetic information or other protected medical condition, political affiliation, or any other characteristic protected by and in accordance with applicable laws. Employees and Applicants can find A&M policy statements and additional information by region here.

Unsolicited Resumes from Third-Party Recruiters

Please note that as per A&M policy, we do not accept unsolicited resumes from third-party recruiters unless such recruiters are engaged to provide candidates for a specified opening. Any employment agency, person or entity that submits an unsolicited resume does so with the understanding that A&M will have the right to hire that applicant at its discretion without any fee owed to the submitting employment agency, person or entity.

title: Analista de Processos Pleno - Salesforce
description:
Overview

Somos uma Travel Tech especializada em aluguel por temporada, parte do Grupo Despegar.com | decolar. com. Nosso software é completo e ajuda administradores de aluguel por temporada ao redor do mundo a gerir o processo de hospedagem em mais de 50 mil imóveis, apoiando na gestão de imóveis, tomada de decisões baseadas em dados, aumento de reservas e automação de áreas de negócio, integrando recursos de alto desempenho. Somos líderes na América Latina. Nosso ambiente de trabalho é aberto a troca de ideias, com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Construímos uma cultura horizontal que valoriza diversidade, pensamento, gênero e pessoas, com os seguintes valores: Trabalho em equipe; Foco no cliente; Resiliência e Adaptabilidade; Foco em resultados; Aprendizagem Contínua; Ética e transparência.

Para esta posição, esperamos que você tenha perfil analítico e experiência prática para sustentar e evoluir os processos da operação da Stays. A missão é garantir que fluxos automatizados sejam eficientes, escaláveis, organizados e bem documentados, conectando áreas de negócio e tecnologia para gerar impacto em performance e eficiência. Além disso, será responsável por apoiar o desenvolvimento e evolução do SDR AI, garantindo que automações de vendas baseadas em IA estejam bem integradas ao Salesforce e sustentadas de forma escalável.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Mapear, documentar e otimizar fluxos de negócio no Salesforce e sistemas satélites.
  • Desenvolver, monitorar e otimizar fluxos relacionados ao SDR AI (Agent Force), garantindo integrações sólidas com Salesforce e demais sistemas.
  • Criar e manter automações no Salesforce (Flows, Process Builder, e APEX quando necessário).
  • Monitorar e corrigir gargalos e incidentes técnicos nos processos existentes.
  • Atuar como guardião da governança da plataforma (padronização, nomenclatura, versionamento).
  • Apoiar integrações entre Salesforce e sistemas legados (RD Station, Botmaker, etc.).
  • Realizar testes, validações e deploys seguros de novos fluxos.
  • Criar e manter listas de segmentação e filtros críticos para operação.
  • Administrar acessos e permissões conforme diretrizes de segurança.
  • Colaborar com Comercial, Marketing e CS para traduzir necessidades em soluções técnicas.
  • Garantir escalabilidade, evitando soluções paliativas e dependências frágeis.
  • Documentar todas as alterações relevantes em repositório atualizado.
  • Atuar como ponto de referência técnica para iniciativas de inteligência artificial aplicadas ao processo comercial.

Requisitos

  • Experiência prática com Salesforce (especialmente Sales Cloud).
  • Domínio na criação de automações via Flows e Process Builder.
  • Capacidade analítica para entender, redesenhar e otimizar processos.
  • Rigor na documentação e organização de fluxos.
  • Boa comunicação para interação com times de negócio.
  • Perfil proativo, orientado à escalabilidade e melhoria contínua.

Diferenciais

  • Certificações Salesforce (Admin, App Builder, Flow Builder).
  • Experiência com AgentForce.
  • Experiência com integrações e automações envolvendo RD Station, Botmaker, WhatsApp, APIs.
  • Conhecimentos em arquitetura de sistemas e governança de dados.
  • Experiência anterior em SaaS, scale-ups ou ambientes de rápido crescimento.

Localização

Estamos localizados em Copacabana, no coração da Zona Sul do Rio de Janeiro.

Observações finais

Este anúncio foca na posição de Analista de Processos Pl conforme descrito. Para conhecer mais sobre a Stays e nosso processo seletivo, acesse nossas redes sociais ou site oficial.

Sobre a Vaga

Job Description
Junta-se a nós e venha trabalhar em uma das maiores empresas especializadas em assistência à aviação no Brasil. ️
A dnata Brasil opera em 30 aeroportos, garantindo que todos os voos recebam o melhor atendimento com o máximo de agilidade; nossas equipes são reconhecidas pela dedicação, profissionalismo, ética, qualidade e expertise apresentados; somos 100% dedicados ao cumprimento de nossas funções .
Globalmente, a dnata foi fundada em 1959, em Dubai. Possuímos mais de 46.000 funcionários divididos em 38 países, nos 6 continentes, com atuação em 136 aeroportos e auxiliando mais de 347 clientes pelo mundo.
Esta é uma vaga exclusiva para o Aeroporto do Galeão (GIG)!
Responsibilities and assignments
Possuímos várias posições disponíveis com foco operacional, as principais sendo:

  • Auxiliar de Rampa
As atividades consistem na movimentação de bagagens da esteira para equipamentos de transporte, calçamento, carregamento e descarregamento de aeronaves com malas e cargas, sinalização em torno do voo a ser atendido, inspeção e varredura do piso para coleta de objetos caídos. Dentre os equipamentos e mobiliários utilizados destacam-se telefone e rádio de comunicação. O setor encontra-se no subsolo, com acesso do colaborador ao posto de trabalho por elevadores e escadas rolantes e deslocamento pelas áreas operacionais do aeroporto.
Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e dos inferiores, postura em bipedestação para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, rotação e flexão do tronco, esforço físico e deambulação por toda área operacional.
Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para movimentação de bagagens da esteira para equipamentos de transporte, calçamento, carregamento e descarregamento de aeronaves com malas e cargas, sinalização em torno do voo a ser atendido, inspeção e varredura do piso para coleta de objetos caídos, percepção auditiva para identificação de sinais sonoros de equipamentos e máquinas na pista.
Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.
  • Auxiliar de Serviços Gerais (Limpeza)
As atividades consistem na organização da bolsa de suprimentos, aguardo da liberação de limpeza pela tripulação, acoplamento da escada na aeronave, coleta dos sacos de lixos, reposição dos suprimentos, aspiração do carpete, verificação da presença de objetos e higienização das poltronas e de bolsões, preenchimento de documentação do voo e limpeza das salas administrativas. Dentre os equipamentos utilizados destacam-se telefone, aspirador, panos, sacos de lixo, lixeira e bolsa de suprimentos. O setor encontra-se no subsolo, com acesso do colaborador ao posto de trabalho por elevadores e escadas rolantes e deslocamento pelas áreas operacionais do aeroporto.
Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e dos inferiores, postura em bipedestação para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, deambulação por toda extensão do aeroporto para o atendimento do voo, rotação e flexão do tronco e esforço físico para limpeza e deslocamento da escada da aeronave.
Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para inspeções e limpezas e percepção auditiva para atendimento telefônico e detecção de sinais sonoros emergenciais em áreas operacionais.
Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.
  • Auxiliar Administrativo (Operações)
As atividades consistem na gestão do faturamento e conciliação documental diária dos voos realizados, encaminhamento para departamento financeiro, elaboração de relatórios, lançamento de dados no sistema, arquivo, leitura e envio de e-mail. Dentre os equipamentos e mobiliários utilizados destacam-se cadeira, mesa, arquivos, microcomputador, impressora com 1,28m de altura do piso e telefone. O setor encontra-se no piso térreo, com deslocamento do colaborador pelas áreas administrativas e operacionais do aeroporto por meio de elevadores e escadas rolantes.
Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e inferiores, postura variável para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, eventualmente existe a necessidade de esforço físico e deambulação entre áreas administrativas e operacionais do aeroporto.
Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para elaboração de relatórios, leitura e elaboração de e-mails, faturamento, lançamento de dados no sistema, e percepção auditiva para atendimento telefônico e aos colaboradores, visitantes e clientes.
Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.

Descrição da vaga

Somos conhecidos por vender o gás que alimenta a mais de 10 milhões de famílias brasileiras em lugares que nenhuma outra energia chega. Entregamos aquele “gás de cozinha” (botijão de 13 kg), mas também instalamos tanques de diversos tamanhos em indústrias, agronegócios, restaurantes, hotéis, lavanderias, casas, condomínios, além de fornecemos cilindros para empilhadeiras.

Pertencemos ao grupo holandês SHV Energy, líder mundial na distribuição de Gás LP, com mais de 100 anos de experiência no setor de energia, além de sermos uma das principais distribuidoras nacionais, com 21% do mercado e mais de 70 anos de atuação.

Por isso, nos dedicamos a construir um ambiente de trabalho propício ao desenvolvimento humano e profissional dos nossos colaboradores, sempre incentivando a interação, a participação ativa e o crescimento. Gostamos de quem acrescenta, porque acreditamos que o sucesso vem da soma da energia com a colaboração.

E o que nós fazemos exatamente?

Somos uma empresa do Grupo SHV Energy, líder mundial na distribuição de GLP e uma das principais distribuidoras de gás LP no Brasil, com mais de 75 anos de atuação. Possuímos o mais moderno parque engarrafador da América Latina e contamos com mais de 20 unidades industriais distribuídas pelo país, de norte a sul. Nossos mais de 4 mil colaboradores nos enchem de orgulho pelo que somos e pelo que fazemos, levando energia para mais de 10 milhões de famílias brasileiras, alcançando locais onde nenhum outro tipo de energia consegue chegar. Além disso, atendemos mais de 60 mil clientes empresariais, desde pequenos comércios até grandes indústrias, incluindo o agronegócio.
